Dynin-Robotics: Omnimodal Unified Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model VLA

vision-language-action model diffusion policy world model multi-task robot learning open x-embodiment

简要说明：Dynin-Robotics 提出了一种统一的扩散视觉-语言-动作模型，通过共享轨迹令牌接口联合学习动作、下一观测、目标和指令预测，在基准测试和真实机器人上提升了操作成功率。

TLDR: Dynin-Robotics presents a unified diffusion VLA model that jointly learns action, next-observation, goal, and instruction prediction through a shared trajectory token interface, improving robot manipulation success on benchmarks and real hardware.

Abstract: Visual goal and dynamics prediction can provide language-conditioned robot policies with both a target outcome and a representation of action-dependent scene changes. We bring these predictions into action generation and selection through a shared trajectory model. Dynin-Robotics implements this formulation on Dynin-Omni, an omnimodal masked-diffusion backbone, representing language, visual observations, goals, and actions as discrete tokens. By varying conditioning and target spans, the same model learns action prediction, action-conditioned next-observation prediction, terminal goal-state prediction, and trajectory-to-instruction reconstruction. These interfaces support test-time scaling through goal prediction, action-candidate evaluation, and joint refinement of action and future-state predictions. We continually pretrain the model on approximately 1.33 million trajectories from 48 Open X-Embodiment datasets and adapt it separately to downstream domains. On two VLABench tasks, robot pretraining improves adaptation within a fixed Stage-2 step budget, and the full objective mixture improves shifted-instruction success over Policy-only post-training under the same coupled decoder. Combining goal guidance with joint action-next-state denoising further improves shifted-instruction success over action-only decoding; the benefit depends on how the predictions are composed. Dynin-Robotics achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, together with a 78.4% average success rate across four manipulation conditions on a Franka Research 3 robot. An optimized block-parallel implementation accelerates model-side action decoding by up to 29.2x relative to the base implementation under the reported profiling setup. These results support shared trajectory modeling as a common interface for learning complementary robot objectives and composing their predictions during control.

摘要（中文）：视觉目标与动力学预测能够为语言条件机器人策略同时提供目标结果及动作依赖场景变化的表征。我们将这些预测通过一个共享轨迹模型引入动作生成与选择过程。Dynin-Robotics在Dynin-Omni——一个全模态掩码扩散骨干网络上实现了该公式，将语言、视觉观测、目标和动作表示为离散标记。通过改变条件片段与目标片段，同一模型可学习动作预测、动作条件下的下一观测预测、最终目标状态预测以及轨迹到指令的重构。这些接口通过目标预测、动作候选评估以及动作与未来状态预测的联合精化支持测试时扩展。我们基于48个Open X-Embodiment数据集中的约133万条轨迹对模型进行持续预训练，并分别适配至下游领域。在两个VLABench任务中，机器人预训练在固定Stage-2步数预算内改善了适配效果，且在相同耦合解码器下，完整目标混合训练相比仅策略后训练显著提升了偏移指令的成功率。将目标引导与联合动作-下一状态去噪相结合，相比仅动作解码进一步提升了偏移指令成功率；其收益取决于预测的组合方式。Dynin-Robotics在LIBERO和零样本LIBERO-Plus上取得了具有竞争力的性能，并在Franka Research 3机器人上的四种操作条件下实现了78.4%的平均成功率。在所报告的剖析配置下，优化后的块并行实现相较于基准实现，将模型侧动作解码速度提升了最高29.2倍。这些结果支持共享轨迹建模作为学习互补机器人目标并在控制过程中组合其预测的统一接口。

Authors: Hoeun Lee, Jaeik Kim, Jusang Oh, Jinhyeok Kim, Geon Choi, Hyeonggeun Kim, Jaeyoung Do

STAR: Sparse Tactile Representation Learning in Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Models for Dexterous Manipulation VLA

vision-tactile-language-action sparse tactile representation dexterous manipulation teleoperation dataset multi-finger control

简要说明：STAR 构建了包含视觉-触觉-语言注释的大规模双手灵巧操作数据集，并提出稀疏触觉表示学习方法，在真实任务中取得 61% 成功率。

TLDR: STAR introduces a large-scale bimanual dexterous manipulation dataset with vision-tactile-language annotations and a sparse tactile representation learning recipe for VTLA models, achieving 61% success on real-world tasks.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires coordinated multi-finger control and effective tactile feedback, yet learning these capabilities remains challenging due to the lack of large-scale real-world data and the difficulty of extracting effective representations from sparse tactile signals. We build a robot platform and teleoperation system to collect a 200-hour bimanual dexterous manipulation dataset with synchronized visual, tactile, and language annotations, comprising 10,576 trajectories across 65 tasks, 69.5% of which involve dexterous multi-finger manipulation. We further propose STAR, an integrated training recipe for vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) models that addresses the spatial, temporal, and informational sparsity of tactile signals through visual-tactile joint pre-training, sparse-global tactile token representation, and sparse future tactile prediction. Trained on this dataset, STAR achieves a 61% average success rate across four real-world tasks with 100 post-training trajectories per task, demonstrating dexterous performance under task-specific post-training.

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作需要协调的多指控制与有效的触觉反馈，然而由于缺乏大规模真实世界数据，以及从稀疏触觉信号中提取有效表征的困难，学习这些能力仍面临挑战。我们构建了一个机器人平台和遥操作系统，收集了一个包含200小时双手灵巧操作数据集，该数据集同步包含视觉、触觉和语言标注，涵盖65个任务中的10，576条轨迹，其中69.5%涉及灵巧多指操作。我们进一步提出了STAR，一种针对视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）模型的集成训练方案，通过视觉-触觉联合预训练、稀疏全局触觉令牌表征和稀疏未来触觉预测，解决了触觉信号在空间、时间和信息上的稀疏性问题。在该数据集上训练后，STAR在每项任务使用100条后训练轨迹的情况下，在四个真实世界任务中实现了61%的平均成功率，展示了在特定任务后训练下的灵巧性能。

Authors: Xiangcheng Liu, Tianhao Wu, Le Zheng, Yidong Wang, Bowen Jiang, Mingjie Pan, Xinlin Ren, Yi Liu, Jianlan Luo

RodForesight: A World Model Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Slender Rod Insertion Manipulation

diffusion policy world model rod insertion visual servoing action-conditioned

简要说明：RodForesight 提出了一种用于细长杆插入的两阶段框架，结合视觉伺服进行粗接近，以及扩散策略和动作条件世界模型进行预测插入，将成功率从 88.9% 提高到 96.7%。

TLDR: RodForesight proposes a two-stage framework for slender rod insertion, combining visual servoing for coarse approaching and a diffusion policy with an action-conditioned world model for predictive insertion, improving success rates from 88.9% to 96.7%.

Abstract: Slender rod insertion arises in precision manufacturing, where millimetre scale diameter and tight clearances demand accurate perception and control. Conventional peg-in-hole methods assume a rigid object whose tip pose is fixed relative to the gripper. This assumption breaks down for a high aspect ratio rod, which can bend during manipulation, making its tip motion dependent on the rod configuration, grasp, material properties, and contact. We present RodForesight, a learning framework that factorises the task into two stages: 1) coarse approaching, which uses visual servoing to map diverse initial configurations into a compact near hole hand-off region; and 2) predictive insertion, which performs fine alignment and completes the insertion. It is worth noting that the two stages can be wrapped into an end-to-end design. During insertion, a diffusion policy generates candidate action chunks, while an action conditioned world model predicts their effects on rod-hole alignment. This pre-execution evaluation enables RodForesight to select the best action chunk based on predicted tilt and radial errors before execution. Experiments investigate the performance of different stages and the end-to-end setting, where RodForesight improves the success rate from 88.9% to 96.7%, compared to baseline methods such as diffusion policy.

摘要（中文）：细长杆插入操作出现在精密制造领域中，此时毫米级直径和极小间隙要求精确的感知与控制。传统的销孔装配方法假设对象为刚体，其末端位姿相对于夹持器固定。然而，这一假设对高长径比杆件不再成立，因为杆件在操作过程中可能发生弯曲，使其末端运动取决于杆件构型、夹持方式、材料特性以及接触状态。我们提出了RodForesight，一种将任务分解为两个阶段的学习框架：1）粗对准接近阶段，利用视觉伺服将多种初始构型映射到一个紧凑的近孔交接区域；2）预测式插入阶段，执行精细对准并完成插入。值得注意的是，这两个阶段可以封装为端到端的设计。在插入过程中，扩散策略生成候选动作块，同时一个以动作条件的世界模型预测这些动作对杆-孔对准的影响。这种执行前评估使RodForesight能够在执行之前基于预测的倾斜误差和径向误差来选择最佳动作块。实验研究了不同阶段以及端到端设置下的性能表现，结果表明，与扩散策略等基线方法相比，RodForesight将成功率从88.9%提升至96.7%。

Authors: Chuanbo Yu, Mingyu Yue, Yan Lyu, Chuhan Song, Peng Wang

UniPart: Towards Zero-shot Language-Grounded 3D Part Segmentation for Embodied Interaction Manipulation

3D part segmentation zero-shot language-grounded point cloud grasping

简要说明：UniPart 提出了一种前馈跨模态 3D Transformer，用于零样本、语言引导的 3D 部件分割，并在大规模数据集上训练，同时展示了在真实世界中语言条件部件抓取的迁移能力。

TLDR: UniPart introduces a feed-forward cross-modal 3D Transformer for zero-shot, language-grounded 3D part segmentation, trained on a large-scale dataset with millions of text-part pairs, and demonstrates real-world transfer to language-conditioned part grasping.

Abstract: Fine-grained robotic manipulation depends on understanding parts, not only whole objects. Existing 3D foundation models tend to be either generalized but object-aware, or part-aware but limited to closed-set taxonomies, which weakens zero-shot transfer. We study text-conditioned 3D part segmentation, where a free-form phrase selects a functional part on point cloud. We introduce UniPart, a feed-forward cross-modal 3D Transformer that conditions CLIP text embedding. To scale supervision, we build LangPart-1M with 160K+ Objaverse assets and 8M text to part pairs using multi-view consistent part generation. We further manually label a high-quality subset, LangPart-4K, for fine-tuning and evaluation. UniPart achieves strong zero-shot results on open-vocabulary part benchmarks and transfers to language-conditioned part grasping in real world.

摘要（中文）：细粒度机器人操作依赖于对部件的理解，而不仅仅是对整体对象的理解。现有的3D基础模型要么具有泛化能力但仅关注对象整体，要么具备部件感知能力但受限于封闭集分类体系，这削弱了零样本迁移的效果。我们研究了文本条件下的3D部件分割任务，即通过自由形式的短语在点云中选择一个功能部件。我们提出了UniPart，一种以前馈方式运行的跨模态3D Transformer，它利用CLIP文本嵌入作为条件。为了扩展监督规模，我们构建了LangPart-1M数据集，包含超过16万个Objaverse资源以及800万个文本到部件的配对，这些配对通过多视角一致的部件生成方法获得。我们还手动标注了一个高质量子集LangPart-4K，用于微调和评估。UniPart在开放词汇部件基准上取得了优异的零样本结果，并成功迁移到现实世界中的语言条件部件抓取任务。

Authors: Xinqiang Yu, Zekun qi, Jiawei He, Wenyao Zhang, Xuchuan Chen, Guaocai Yao, Li Yi, Zhaoxiang Zhang, He Wang

Improving Imitation Learning Efficiency for Manipulation through Geometric Prior Pretraining Manipulation

geometric prior pretraining imitation learning manipulation sample efficiency

简要说明：该论文提出一种几何预训练策略，利用由平面、物体和立方体手组成的无纹理简化场景来初始化模仿学习策略，从而提升模拟和真实机器人操作的样本效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a geometric pretraining strategy that uses simple, texture-free scenes of a plane, object, and cube-shaped hand to initialize imitation learning policies, improving sample efficiency for manipulation tasks across simulated and real robots.

Abstract: Applying an imitation learning policy to a new manipulation task usually requires collecting new demonstrations and retraining the model, which makes sample efficiency a practical concern. Pretraining on large-scale robot datasets is effective in this respect, but such datasets are costly to collect and train on, while data augmentation techniques typically require a new round of data generation and retraining for each task. A complementary question is what useful prior can be provided to a policy at negligible cost before any task-specific data are collected. In this study, we construct a geometric visual pretraining dataset in which each scene contains only a plane, an object, and a hand, and trajectories are generated automatically. The scenes contain neither textures nor backgrounds; pretraining primarily exposes the policy to the geometric relationship between the hand and the object. Furthermore, representing the hand as a cube avoids tailoring the dataset to a specific robot morphology. We evaluate this geometric prior using ACT on three simulated robots across five manipulation tasks each, as well as on three real-world robot tasks. Across many of these robot--task combinations, fine-tuning from the geometric prior achieves higher success rates in the early stages of training than training from scratch while using only a small number of task demonstrations. These results suggest that even highly simplified geometric scenes can provide a useful initialization that transfers across robots and to real-world tasks when task data are limited.

摘要（中文）：将模仿学习策略应用于新的操作任务，通常需要收集新的示范数据并重新训练模型，这使得样本效率成为一个实际问题。在大规模机器人数据集上进行预训练在此方面是有效的，但此类数据集的收集和训练成本高昂，而数据增强技术通常需要针对每项任务进行新一轮的数据生成和重新训练。一个补充性的问题是，在收集任何任务特定数据之前，能以极低成本为策略提供哪些有用的先验。在本研究中，我们构建了一个几何视觉预训练数据集，其中每个场景仅包含一个平面、一个物体和一只手，轨迹自动生成。场景中既无纹理也无背景；预训练主要让策略接触手与物体之间的几何关系。此外，将手表示为立方体，避免了对特定机器人形态进行数据集定制。我们使用ACT在三个模拟机器人上，针对每项机器人各五项操作任务，以及三项真实世界机器人任务，评估了这一几何先验。在许多机器人-任务组合中，与从头训练相比，从几何先验进行微调在训练早期阶段取得了更高的成功率，且仅需少量任务示范。这些结果表明，即使是高度简化的几何场景，也能在任务数据有限的情况下提供一种有用的初始化，且该初始化可跨机器人迁移并适用于真实世界任务。

Authors: Shogo Iwakata, Tomohiro Motoda, Ryosuke Yamada, Koshi Makihara, Ryoichi Nakajo, Keitaro Tanaka, Masaki Murooka, Roman Mykhailyshyn, Hirokatsu Kataoka, Shigeo Morishima, Yukiyasu Domae

Size Doesn't Matter: Material-State Reinforcement Learning for Excavator Transferable Soil Manipulation Manipulation

Material Point Method Reinforcement Learning Excavator Soil Manipulation Sim-to-Real Transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于挖掘机土壤操作的强化学习方法，利用GPU并行物质点法模拟和基于材料状态的策略，并展示了在不同尺寸机器上的成功迁移以及自主路基建设。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach for excavator soil manipulation, using GPU-parallelized Material Point Method simulations and material-state-conditioned policies, and demonstrates successful transfer across different machine sizes with autonomous embankment construction.

Abstract: Earthmoving tasks such as excavation, backfilling, or embankment construction require deliberate repositioning of deformable soil. For these tasks, human operators use all shovel faces, while autonomous systems so far are limited to excavation and dumping. Current methods often rely on heuristic models but do not incorporate soil mechanics. We address this shortcoming by using Reinforcement Learning in a GPU-parallelized Material Point Method particle simulation. Our controllers are conditioned on material state such as shape and compactness, enabling skills that use multiple contact faces of the tool and displace material both inside and outside of the shovel. To use the same learned weights across machines, our policies operate in a normalized end-effector space and are deployed through a calibrated machine interface. We evaluate this calibrated transfer on an 11.5t hydraulic excavator and a 500g tabletop robot. We validate performance through autonomous construction of a 42m long, 2.1m high embankment in 45min, executing 201 individual policy strokes without failure, retry, or operator intervention. In a direct comparison, the autonomous controller matches an expert operator's progression speed and produces a higher, more consistent embankment. Additional qualitative backfilling and compaction experiments demonstrate the material-state awareness and calibrated transfer across machines.

摘要（中文）：土方工程任务，如挖掘、回填或堤坝建设，需要慎重地重新定位可变形土壤。对于这些任务，人工操作员会利用铲斗的所有工作面，而目前自主系统仅限于挖掘和倾倒作业。现有方法往往依赖启发式模型，但未融入土壤力学原理。我们通过在GPU并行化的物质点法粒子模拟中运用强化学习来解决这一不足。我们的控制器以材料状态（如形状和密实度）为条件，能够实现使用工具多个接触面的技能，并可在铲斗内外移动物料。为了在不同机器上使用相同的学习权重，我们的策略在归一化的末端执行器空间中运行，并通过校准的机器接口进行部署。我们在一台11.5吨的液压挖掘机和一台500克的桌面机器人上评估了这种校准转移的效果。通过自主建造一条长42米、高2.1米的堤坝，用时45分钟，执行201次策略动作，无故障、无重试、无需操作员干预，我们验证了其性能。在直接对比中，自主控制器达到了专家操作员的推进速度，并建造出了更高、更均匀的堤坝。额外的定性回填和压实实验展示了材料状态感知能力以及跨机器的校准转移效果。

Authors: Lennart Werner, Pol Eyschen, Sean Costello, Pierluigi Micarelli, Andrei Cramariuc, Marco Hutter

Breaking the Vision-Action Shortcut: Latent Interface Training for Generalizable Robotics Foundation Models VLA

vision-action shortcut latent interface distribution shift robot foundation models action prior

简要说明：本文提出潜在接口训练（LIT），一种两阶段策略，通过先基于目标位姿学习动作先验，再通过位姿监督的潜在接口约束视觉条件，防止机器人基础模型中的视觉-动作捷径，从而提升在视觉分布变化下的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Latent Interface Training (LIT), a two-stage strategy to prevent vision-action shortcuts in robot foundation models by first learning an action prior from goal poses, then constraining visual conditioning through a pose-supervised latent interface, improving robustness to visual distribution shifts across multiple VLA and world-action architectures.

Abstract: Robot foundation models achieve strong in-distribution performance but often degrade under visual distribution shifts. When learning to generate actions from pretrained visual representations, models may exploit task-irrelevant visual cues that correlate with demonstrated actions within the training distribution. Such vision-action shortcuts can undermine generalization when these correlations change under distribution shifts. Mitigating these shortcuts requires constraining how visual information is used for action generation while preserving task-relevant spatial information. We propose Latent Interface Training (LIT), a framework-agnostic two-stage strategy that first establishes a spatial-goal-conditioned action prior without images, then constrains visual conditioning through a pose-supervised latent interface. Stage 1 trains the action expert to generate action chunks conditioned on language, robot state, and each demonstrated chunk's terminal SE(3) end-effector pose, learning goal-directed action generation independently of visual cues. Stage 2 introduces a latent interface that aggregates visual and semantic representations and serves as the pretrained action expert's only visual conditioning pathway. The interface is supervised to reconstruct the terminal pose previously used to condition Stage 1, encouraging it to retain the goal-relevant spatial information needed for action generation. Across four vision-language-action and world-action architectures (Pi0.5, MolmoAct2, FAST-WAM, and ImageWAM), LIT improves overall LIBERO-Plus success by 3.87-10.70 percentage points while preserving or improving average LIBERO success. Real-world evaluations show 13.30-16.70 percentage-point gains in success aggregated across three tasks under unseen camera configurations, lighting variations, and distractors.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 机器人基础模型在分布内表现优异，但在视觉分布偏移下性能往往会退化。当从预训练的视觉表示中学习生成动作时，模型可能会利用与演示动作在训练分布内相关的任务无关视觉线索。当这些相关性在分布偏移下发生变化时，这种视觉-动作捷径会损害泛化能力。缓解这些捷径需要在保留任务相关空间信息的同时，约束视觉信息用于动作生成的方式。我们提出潜在接口训练（LIT），一种框架无关的两阶段策略，首先在无图像条件下建立基于空间目标条件的动作先验，然后通过姿态监督的潜在接口约束视觉条件化。第一阶段训练动作专家，使其基于语言、机器人状态以及每个演示片段末端的SE(3)末端执行器姿态生成动作块，从而独立于视觉线索学习目标导向的动作生成。第二阶段引入潜在接口，聚合视觉和语义表示，并作为预训练动作专家唯一的视觉条件化通路。该接口受监督以重建第一阶段条件化所用的末端姿态，促使其保留动作生成所需的目标相关空间信息。在四种视觉-语言-动作和世界-动作架构（Pi0.5、MolmoAct2、FAST-WAM和ImageWAM）中，LIT将LIBERO-Plus总体成功率提升了3.87至10.70个百分点，同时保持或提升了LIBERO平均成功率。真实世界评估显示，在未见过的相机配置、光照变化和干扰物条件下，三个任务的成功率综合提升了13.30至16.70个百分点。

Authors: Jianman Lin, Shailesh Shailesh, Zhongyi Luo, Jiafei Duan

Online Material Estimation for Conditioned Diffusion Policy in Shaping Deformable Linear Objects Manipulation

diffusion policy deformable linear objects material estimation imitation learning real robot

简要说明：本文提出一种基于在线估计材料标签的扩散策略，用于塑造可变形线性物体，在真实机器人实验中达到了与使用真实材料信息相当的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a diffusion policy conditioned on online-estimated material labels for shaping deformable linear objects, achieving performance comparable to using ground-truth material information in real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Shape control of deformable linear objects (DLOs) is challenging for imitation learning because deformation behavior varies with material properties such as stiffness and elasticity, so a single policy must generate different action sequences for different objects even when the goal shape is identical. We propose a diffusion policy conditioned on material labels that are estimated online during manipulation. A recurrent estimation network predicts the material label of the grasped object from the time series of multi-view images and robot joint states, and the predicted label conditions the diffusion policy at every inference step. We collected 480 real-robot demonstrations covering four DLO materials and three groove-placement tasks, and compared per-material specialist policies, a task-conditioned policy without material labels, a policy conditioned on ground-truth material labels, and the proposed policy. Conditioning on ground-truth material labels improved the average success rate from 45.8% to 60.0% over the task-only policy, and the proposed policy reached 60.8% without any prior material information, matching the policy given ground-truth labels. A post-hoc analysis shows that the estimator extracts material-related information from the manipulation observations and that the diffusion policy responds to the resulting conditioning signal, while the one pronounced failure case is associated with persistent confusion between two similar materials.

摘要（中文）：可变形线性物体（DLOs）的形状控制对模仿学习而言具有挑战性，因为变形行为随刚度、弹性等材料属性而变化，因此即便目标形状相同，单一策略也必须针对不同物体生成不同的动作序列。我们提出了一种以材料标签为条件的扩散策略，该材料标签在操作过程中在线估计。一个循环估计网络从多视角图像和机器人关节状态的时间序列中预测被抓取物体的材料标签，并在每次推理步骤中以预测标签作为扩散策略的条件。我们收集了涵盖四种DLO材料和三种凹槽放置任务的480条真实机器人演示数据，并对比了每种材料专用的专家策略、无材料标签的任务条件策略、基于真实材料标签的条件策略以及所提出的策略。与仅基于任务条件的策略相比，基于真实材料标签的条件策略将平均成功率从45.8%提升至60.0%，而所提出的策略在无任何先验材料信息的情况下达到了60.8%的成功率，与基于真实标签的策略表现相当。事后分析表明，估计器从操作观测中提取了与材料相关的信息，扩散策略对由此产生的条件信号作出响应，而唯一显著的失败案例与两种相似材料之间的持续混淆有关。

Authors: Ryunosuke Yamada, Tomohiro Motoda, Yukiyasu Domae, Tokuo Tsuji

ArtManip: Category-Level Articulated In-Hand Manipulation Manipulation

category-level manipulation in-hand manipulation articulated objects dexterous hands sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：ArtManip 提出了首个类别级铰接物体手内操控方法，通过自动化生成多样物体与抓取以及两阶段策略学习，实现了在 12 个真实物体上的零样本迁移。

TLDR: ArtManip introduces the first category-level in-hand manipulation method for articulated objects, using an automated pipeline for diverse object and grasp generation and a two-stage policy learning strategy to achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across 12 real objects.

Abstract: Category-level in-hand manipulation of articulated objects is a formidable yet underexplored challenge for dexterous robotic hands. This difficulty stems from two core bottlenecks: first, controlling an object's internal degrees of freedom is tightly coupled with maintaining grasp stability on a free-floating base; second, acquiring diverse object models and functional grasps at scale is highly labor-intensive, yet vital for generalization given the system's sensitivity to initial configurations. In this work, we present ArtManip, the first category-level articulated in-hand manipulation method that generalizes across object instances and diverse initial grasps. For initial configuration construction, we develop an automated pipeline that procedurally generates diverse articulated objects and synthesizes task-oriented functional grasps. For policy learning, we propose a robust two-stage training strategy that incorporates articulation physics randomization, reward curriculum, and latent representation distillation to handle complex contact and joint dynamics during deployment. Extensive experiments across four object categories demonstrate that our policy generalizes to unseen instances and varied configurations in simulation, and achieves zero-shot transfer to 12 real-world objects featuring diverse shapes and joint mechanics.

摘要（中文）：类别级别的关节物体手内操作对于灵巧机械手而言，是一项艰巨且尚未充分探索的挑战。这一困难源于两个核心瓶颈：首先，控制物体的内部自由度与在自由漂浮基座上保持抓取稳定性紧密耦合；其次，大规模获取多样化的物体模型和功能性抓取高度劳动密集，然而鉴于系统对初始配置的敏感性，这对于泛化至关重要。在本工作中，我们提出了ArtManip，这是首个类别级别的关节手内操作方法，能够跨物体实例和多样化初始抓取进行泛化。对于初始配置构建，我们开发了一个自动化流程，程序化生成多样化的关节物体并合成面向任务的功能性抓取。对于策略学习，我们提出了一种稳健的两阶段训练策略，融合了关节物理随机化、奖励课程和潜在表示蒸馏，以应对部署过程中复杂的接触和关节动力学。跨四个物体类别的大量实验表明，我们的策略在仿真中能够泛化到未见实例和多样化配置，并实现了对12个具有不同形状和关节机制的真实世界物体的零样本迁移。

Authors: Yang Yang, Tengyu Liu, Puhao Li, Zeyuan Chen, Yuyang Li, Xingwan Wang, Yingying Wu, Zhaopeng Cui, Siyuan Huang

IMPLY: Physically Anchored Consistency for World-Model Rollouts WorldModel

world model rollout evaluation physical consistency simulator inversion V-JEPA

简要说明：IMPLY提出了一种基于物理锚定一致性的世界模型 rollout 评估方法，通过反演模拟器推断物理属性并锚定到校准观察，优于自一致性检测忽略对象的模型。

TLDR: IMPLY proposes a physically anchored consistency score for world-model rollouts, which evaluates rollouts by inverting a simulator to infer implied physical properties and anchoring them to calibration observations, outperforming self-consistency in detecting object-ignoring models.

Abstract: A world model asked what happens if an object is pushed at several speeds produces several futures. If the model has the object in mind, those futures agree about it: each implies the same mass and friction. The consistency checks now used to vet world-action models ask whether a model's futures agree with each other, and none of them knows any physics. We show that this is not enough, and what to do instead. IMPLY reads the physics each rollout implies by inverting a simulator and scores a set of rollouts by how well one object explains all of them, anchored to two calibration pushes the model has observed. In a controlled setting, self-consistency gives a perfect score to a model that ignores the object and always predicts a typical push; anchoring exposes it (AUROC 0.70 versus 1.00). On a real model, V-JEPA 2-AC adapted to the scene, the same thing happens. Given its own calibration pushes the model tracks the object (per-object correlation with the truth 0.91); given another object's, it does not (0.05). Self-consistency cannot tell these apart, preferring the right evidence on 52% of objects, chance level, while anchored disagreement prefers it on 73% and correlates 0.92-0.99 with the rollouts' error. Used to choose among candidate rollout sets, it comes within 0.003 of an oracle that sees the truth. A model that has internalised the wrong object is exactly as self-consistent as one that has internalised the right one; consistency has to be anchored to evidence.

摘要（中文）：一个世界模型，当被问及物体以不同速度被推动时会发生什么，会生成多种未来情景。如果模型对物体有正确的认知，这些未来情景在该物体上会达成一致：每个情景都暗示着相同的质量和摩擦力。目前用于评估世界-行动模型的一致性检验，只检查模型生成的未来情景是否彼此一致，而这些检验并不涉及任何物理知识。我们证明这还不够，并提出了替代方案。IMPLY方法通过逆向模拟器解读每次未来推演所隐含的物理参数，并以一个物体能否最好地解释所有推演结果来对一组推演评分，同时锚定于模型已观察到的两次校准推动。在受控环境中，自一致性会给一个忽略物体、总是预测典型推动的模型满分，而锚定方法则能揭露其缺陷（AUROC 0.70对比1.00）。在真实模型V-JEPA 2-AC适应场景的情况下，同样的问题也会出现。当模型使用自身的校准推动时，它能够跟踪物体（每个物体的真实值相关性为0.91）；而当使用其他物体的校准推动时，则无法跟踪（相关性为0.05）。自一致性无法区分这两种情况，在52%的物体上偏好正确的证据，相当于随机水平，而锚定不一致性则在73%的物体上偏好正确的证据，并且与推演误差的相关性达0.92-0.99。当用于在候选推演集中选择时，锚定方法的表现与能看见真实结果的“神谕”仅相差0.003。一个内化了错误物体的模型，与内化了正确物体的模型，在自一致性上完全相同；一致性必须锚定于证据。

Authors: Aman Mehta, Riya Baviskar

FoldNet++: a Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Robotic T-Shirt Folding and Unfolding Manipulation

synthetic dataset T-shirt folding deformable manipulation visuomotor policies sim-to-real

简要说明：FoldNet++ 提出了一个用于机器人T恤折叠和展开的大规模合成数据集，包含多种机器人形态和丰富的环境，实验表明仅在此合成数据上训练的视觉运动策略在真实世界的未见T恤上成功率超过90%。

TLDR: FoldNet++ introduces a large-scale synthetic dataset for robotic T-shirt folding and unfolding with diverse embodiments and environments, and shows that visuomotor policies trained solely on this synthetic data achieve over 90% success on real-world unseen T-shirts.

Abstract: Due to the highly deformable nature of garments, training a generalizable policy for robotic T-shirt folding and unfolding remains a significant challenge. In this work, we present a large-scale synthetic dataset for robotic T-shirt folding and unfolding, covering 6 robotic embodiments, 1K T-shirts, 1K environmental assets, and 120K episodes with rich annotations, which can be used to train a wide range of manipulation policies. We first follow the FoldNet pipeline to generate a large-scale dataset of physically simulatable T-shirts with diverse appearances and annotated semantic keypoints. Based on these semantic keypoints, we then generate manipulation demonstrations for different robotic embodiments through a unified rule-based framework. We use these demonstrations to train visuomotor policies, and experimental results demonstrate that models trained solely on our synthetic data can achieve over 90\% end-to-end task success rates when directly deployed to unseen real-world environments and previously unseen T-shirts from arbitrary initial configurations. Project URL: https://pku-epic.github.io/FoldNetXX/.

摘要（中文）：由于衣物具有高度可变形特性，训练一个具有泛化能力的机器人T恤折叠与展开策略仍然是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一个大规模机器人T恤折叠与展开的合成数据集，涵盖6种机器人本体、1000件T恤、1000个环境资产以及12万条带有丰富标注的数据片段，可用于训练多种操作策略。我们首先遵循FoldNet流程，生成了一个大规模、外观多样且带有语义关键点标注的物理可仿真T恤数据集。基于这些语义关键点，我们随后通过统一的基于规则的框架，为不同机器人本体生成了操作演示。我们利用这些演示来训练视觉运动策略，实验结果表明，仅基于我们的合成数据训练的模型，在直接部署到未见过的真实环境以及任意初始构型的未见T恤时，端到端任务成功率可超过90%。项目网址：https://pku-epic.github.io/FoldNetXX/。

Authors: Yuxing Chen, Zhiyuan Wei, Bowen Xiao, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang

Decentralized Evolution of Hexapod Gaits with Independent Leg Controllers Locomotion

hexapod decentralized evolution gait optimization Webots simulator emergent coordination

简要说明：本文通过分散式进化算法独立演化六足机器人腿部步态，在仿真中实现突发协调，并比协同进化方法更稳定高效。

TLDR: This paper evolves hexapod leg gaits independently via decentralized evolutionary algorithms in simulation, showing emergent coordination and improved stability over cooperative coevolution.

Abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to hexapod locomotion by evolving each leg's gait independently through a decentralized evolutionary algorithm. Using the Webots simulator and the Mantis hexapod robot, we optimize individual leg controllers without centralized coordination, allowing emergent behaviors to drive the development of efficient, coordinated locomotion. Our decentralized method is benchmarked against cooperative coevolution, demonstrating improved efficacy in generating stable and adaptive gaits while showing interesting emergent coordination. By enabling independent evolution of leg controllers, this method reduces the complexity of gait optimization and highlights the potential of decentralized strategies for scalable and adaptive robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种通过分散式进化算法独立演化六足机器人每条腿步态的新方法。利用Webots仿真器和Mantis六足机器人平台，我们在无集中协调的情况下优化各腿控制器，使涌现行为驱动高效协调运动的发展。我们将该分散式方法与协同共进化方法进行了对比基准测试，结果表明该方法在生成稳定且适应性强的步态方面具有更优效果，并展现出有趣的涌现协调现象。通过允许腿控制器独立进化，该方法降低了步态优化的复杂性，并凸显了分散式策略在可扩展和自适应机器人系统中的潜力。

Authors: Gary B. Parker, John Asaro, Jim O'Connor

READ: Learning Risk-Informed Fields for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

risk field end-to-end planning spatiotemporal field VLA NAVSIM

简要说明：READ学习一种显式的、与规划对齐的时空风险场，用于端到端自动驾驶，改善轨迹与低风险区域的对齐，并可集成到VLA模型中。

TLDR: READ learns an explicit, planning-aligned spatiotemporal risk field for end-to-end autonomous driving, improving trajectory alignment with low-risk regions and integrating with VLA models.

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires more than recognizing what is present in a scene: a planner must determine how road structure, surrounding agents, and their motion states should influence a future maneuver. Existing learning-based planners can capture these influences through latent scene features and trajectory decoders, but the relationship between environmental factors and candidate actions often remains implicit. This limits the ability to inspect, diagnose, or refine how scene context affects the safety of a predicted trajectory. Classical safety fields provide an explicit spatial representation of this relationship, but their risk shapes and relative weights are prescribed in advance and do not adapt to each scene. We introduce READ, a framework that learns an explicit, planning-aligned risk representation from complementary geometric and behavioral constraints. READ instantiates this representation as a continuous spatiotemporal field, enabling differentiable queries along candidate trajectories. The learned field connects scene understanding with action selection by encouraging predicted trajectories to align with low-risk regions, while retaining a differentiable interface for trajectory evaluation and refinement. READ integrates with both end-to-end planners and Vision-Language-Action models. Experiments on NAVSIM show consistent gains across matched end-to-end backbones and strong performance in a VLA setting; READ also achieves competitive results on NAVSIM v2. These results establish learned spatial risk as an explicit, adaptable representation for safe planning.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶的要求不止于识别场景中存在什么：规划器必须确定道路结构、周围智能体及其运动状态应如何影响未来的驾驶操作。现有的基于学习的规划器可以通过潜在场景特征和轨迹解码器来捕捉这些影响，但环境因素与候选动作之间的关系往往仍然隐含在内。这限制了检查、诊断或优化场景上下文如何影响预测轨迹安全性的能力。经典安全场提供了这种关系的显式空间表示，但其风险形态和相对权重是预先设定的，不会随每个场景进行调整。我们提出了READ，一个从互补的几何与行为约束中学习显式、面向规划的风险表示的框架。READ将该表示实例化为一个连续时空场，支持沿候选轨迹进行可微查询。所学习的场将场景理解与动作选择连接起来，通过鼓励预测轨迹与低风险区域对齐，同时保留用于轨迹评估和优化的可微接口。READ既可集成到端到端规划器中，也可集成到视觉-语言-动作模型中。在NAVSIM上的实验显示，在对应的端到端骨干网络上取得了一致的性能提升，并在VLA设置中表现强劲；READ在NAVSIM v2上也取得了具有竞争力的结果。这些实验结果确立了学习到的空间风险可作为安全规划的显式、可适应表示。

Authors: Zhiyuan Liu, Yuanxin Tian, Zehong Ke, Jinhao Li, Hao Cheng, Zhenhua Xu, Wenhao Yu, Jianqiang Wang

DWMP: Leveraging Dual World Models for Humanoid Obstacle Traversal HumanoidEmbodied

dual world models Koopman operator RSSM humanoid obstacle traversal Unitree G1

简要说明：DWMP 提出了一种双世界模型策略，结合基于Koopman的动力学模型处理本体感觉和基于RSSM的视觉世界模型处理深度观测，在仿真和Unitree G1人形机器人上提升了越障性能。

TLDR: DWMP presents a dual world model policy that combines a Koopman-based dynamics model for proprioception and an RSSM-based visual world model for egocentric depth, improving humanoid obstacle traversal in simulation and on a Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Humanoid robots must traverse cluttered obstacle fields using onboard proprioceptive and visual observations, yet existing methods usually process multimodal observations without explicitly considering their different characteristics: proprioceptive observations are low-dimensional but governed by highly nonlinear robot dynamics, while egocentric visual observations are high-dimensional, noisy, and redundant. We propose DWMP (Dual World Model Policy), a framework that provides the actor with separate but complementary world-model representations for humanoid obstacle traversal. A Koopman-based dynamics world model lifts proprioceptive observations into a latent space where their temporal evolution is approximately linear, making the dynamics features easier for the actor to learn from. An RSSM-based visual world model compresses egocentric depth observations into compact stochastic states while preserving obstacle-related geometry. The student policy receives the fused latent representation for action generation, combining linearized proprioceptive dynamics with compressed visual perception. Experiments in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot show that DWMP improves obstacle traversal performance over baselines and supports real-world deployment under randomized obstacle layouts.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人必须利用机载本体感觉和视觉观测穿越杂乱障碍区域，然而现有方法通常处理多模态观测时未明确考虑其不同特性：本体感觉观测维度低，但受高度非线性的机器人动力学支配，而自我中心视觉观测维度高、含噪声且存在冗余。我们提出DWMP（双世界模型策略），该框架为执行器提供分离但互补的世界模型表示，用于人形机器人障碍穿越。基于Koopman的动力学世界模型将本体感觉观测提升至潜空间，在其中其时间演化近似线性，使动力学特征更易于执行器学习。基于RSSM的视觉世界模型将自我中心深度观测压缩为紧凑的随机状态，同时保留与障碍物相关的几何信息。学生策略接收融合后的潜表示以生成动作，将线性化的本体感觉动力学与压缩的视觉感知相结合。在仿真及宇树G1人形机器人上的实验表明，DWMP在障碍穿越性能上优于基线方法，并支持在随机障碍布局下的实际部署。

Authors: Rongjun Jin, Jianming Ma, Yue Gao

DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task and Motion Planning for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Task and Motion Planning Vision-Language-Action Models Distribution Alignment Fine-tuning Robot Manipulation

简要说明：DATAFARM 将 TAMP 生成的机器人轨迹与预训练数据分布对齐，以改进 VLA 微调，在桌面操作和布折叠任务上优于原始 TAMP，接近人类遥操作水平。

TLDR: DATAFARM aligns TAMP-generated robot trajectories with the pretraining data distribution to improve VLA fine-tuning, outperforming raw TAMP and approaching human teleoperation on tabletop manipulation and cloth-folding tasks.

Abstract: Collecting high-quality robot data remains a fundamental challenge for training robot foundation models. Task and motion planning (TAMP) offers a scalable way to generate demonstrations, but our experiments show that raw TAMP trajectories provide surprisingly little benefit when used to fine-tune pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models, despite successfully solving the target tasks. We hypothesize that this failure arises from a behavioral distribution mismatch between planner-generated trajectories and the data used to pretrain the VLA. To address this mismatch, we introduce DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task And motion planning for Fine-tuning A Robot foundation Model, an approach that incorporates the pretraining distribution directly into TAMP trajectory generation. DATAFARM aligns generated trajectories with the pretraining data in robot joint configurations, motion style, and temporal execution profiles. We evaluate DATAFARM on three tabletop manipulation tasks that TAMP can perform and a cloth-folding task beyond the capability of TAMP. DATAFARM achieves an average success rate of 56.7%, substantially outperforming raw TAMP (8.3%) while approaching human teleoperation (61.7%). On Deformable Object Manipulation, which is outside the fine-tuning distribution, the fine-tuned model retains 85% success, compared with 90% for the pretrained model. These results show that aligning planner-generated demonstrations with the pretraining distribution can make TAMP an effective source of data for VLA fine-tuning. Website and code: https://prpl-group.com/datafarm/

摘要（中文）：收集高质量的机器人数据仍是训练机器人基础模型面临的根本挑战。任务与运动规划（TAMP）为生成示范数据提供了一种可扩展的途径，但我们的实验表明，尽管原始TAMP轨迹能够成功解决目标任务，将其用于微调预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，却几乎没有带来任何收益。我们推测，这一失败源于规划器生成的轨迹与预训练VLA所使用的数据之间存在行为分布不匹配。为了解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出了DATAFARM：面向机器人基础模型微调的分布对齐任务与运动规划方法，该方法将预训练分布直接纳入TAMP轨迹生成过程中。DATAFARM在机器人关节构型、运动风格和时间执行特征三个方面使生成的轨迹与预训练数据对齐。我们在TAMP能够执行的三个桌面操作任务以及一个超出TAMP能力的叠布任务上对DATAFARM进行了评估。DATAFARM的平均成功率达到56.7%，显著优于原始TAMP（8.3%），并接近人类遥操作的水平（61.7%）。在可变形物体操作任务中，由于该任务处于微调分布之外，微调后的模型保持了85%的成功率，而预训练模型为90%。这些结果表明，将规划器生成的示范数据与预训练分布对齐，可以使TAMP成为VLA微调的有效数据来源。网站与代码：https://prpl-group.com/datafarm/

Authors: Samrat Sahoo, Yixuan Huang, Tom Silver

AnchorVLN: Geometry-Anchored Vision-Language Grounding Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation open-vocabulary grounding geometry anchoring Model Context Protocol embodied agent

简要说明：AnchorVLN 提出了一种几何锚定的开放词汇视觉语言导航系统，通过 MCP 服务器实现 VLM 提出语义、几何决定度量的规则，在 CMU VLN 挑战赛中提升了指令跟随和物体引用性能。

TLDR: AnchorVLN introduces a geometry-anchored open-vocabulary VLN system where a VLM proposes semantics and geometry decides metrics via an MCP server, improving instruction following and object reference on the CMU VLN Challenge 2026.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) in unseen indoor environments is useful in real-world robotics, where an agent must follow natural-language instructions, locate objects, and answer spatial questions without a pre-built map or fixed object vocabulary. Multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) provide strong open-vocabulary grounding and zero-shot reasoning, but struggle to emit reliable metric quantities such as range, bearing, and comparative spatial relations directly from images. Existing approaches address this by folding geometry into hand-engineered pipelines or asking models to output waypoints, requiring changes to the control stack for different robots, tasks, or vocabularies. We introduce AnchorVLN, an open-vocabulary VLN system built on a simple rule: the VLM proposes semantics; geometry decides metrics. It is realised as EMBODIED-NAV-MCP, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server driven by a VLM agent through a compact set of callable tools. Since no tool accepts distance in metres or bearing in radians, the schema enforces the semantic-geometry boundary without modifying the downstream autonomy stack. We benchmark both tasks of the CMU Vision-Language Navigation Challenge 2026: 30 instruction-following questions over 15 scenes and a frozen 45-question object-reference set. The full system achieves 64.4 percent on instruction following, dropping by 13.3 percentage points without controller modeling (t = 2.77). On object reference, geometric anchoring clears the challenge overlap threshold on 10 of 45 questions, versus 0 of 45 for direct coordinate estimation, reducing median center error from 3.37 m to 2.48 m.

摘要（中文）：在未见过的室内环境中进行视觉-语言导航（VLN）对现实世界机器人具有实用价值，智能体必须遵循自然语言指令、定位物体并在没有预建地图或固定物体词汇的情况下回答空间问题。多模态视觉-语言模型（VLM）提供了强大的开放词汇 grounding 能力和零样本推理能力，但在直接从图像输出可靠的度量量（如距离、方位和比较性空间关系）方面存在困难。现有方法通过将几何信息嵌入手工设计的流程中，或要求模型输出路径点来解决这一问题，但这种方式需要针对不同机器人、任务或词汇修改控制栈。我们提出 AnchorVLN，一种基于简单规则的开放词汇 VLN 系统：VLM 提供语义，几何决定度量。该系统以 EMBODIED-NAV-MCP 的形式实现，这是一个由 VLM 智能体通过一组紧凑的可调用工具驱动的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器。由于没有任何工具接受以米为单位的距离或以弧度为单位的方位角，该架构在不修改下游自主控制栈的情况下强制执行语义与几何之间的边界。我们在 CMU 视觉-语言导航挑战赛 2026 的两个任务上进行了基准测试：15 个场景中的 30 个指令遵循问题，以及一个固定的 45 个问题物体引用集合。完整系统在指令遵循任务上达到 64.4% 的准确率，移除控制器建模后下降 13.3 个百分点（t = 2.77）。在物体引用任务上，几何锚定在 45 个问题中有 10 个超过了挑战重叠阈值，而直接坐标估计在 45 个问题中为 0 个，中位中心误差从 3.37 米降低到 2.48 米。

Authors: Long Giang Vu, Chengkai Yao, Yuxin Liu, FNU Aryan, Rajath Chandrashekar Aralikatti

Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning Manipulation

3D Diffusion Policy Object-aware Attentional Conditioning Point Clouds Manipulation

简要说明：Attention-DP3通过三场注意力条件化向3D扩散策略注入空间物体感知几何线索，在杂乱和遮挡场景下提升了操作性能，并在多个基准和真实世界测试中取得领先。

TLDR: Attention-DP3 enhances 3D diffusion policies with spatially object-aware geometric cues via Tri-field Attentional Conditioning, improving manipulation performance under clutter and occlusion across multiple benchmarks and real-world tests.

Abstract: 3D point-cloud observations are inherently ambiguous in complex, cluttered manipulation scenes, where target objects may be partially occluded or tightly intermingled with visually similar distractors. As a result, standard 3D diffusion policies often struggle to localize and exploit task-relevant geometry as scene complexity grows. We propose \textbf{Attention-DP3}, a spatially object-aware 3D diffusion policy that injects object-level geometric cues via attention while keeping the DP3 diffusion backbone unchanged. Our pipeline performs open-vocabulary 2D segmentation on RGB images, then lifts predicted target masks into 3D using calibrated camera geometry to obtain object-centric geometric priors. We incorporate these cues through Tri-field Attentional Conditioning, which constructs three complementary fields: (i) a targetness field to anchor the target object, (ii) an intra-target saliency field to emphasize task-relevant geometry within the target, and (iii) a backgroundness field to suppress distractors and clutter. Experiments on Adroit, DexArt, MetaWorld, and the real-world SO101 platform show consistent improvements over DP3, achieving state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks. Notably, as distractor objects increase, DP3 drops sharply, whereas Attention-DP3 remains stable and outperforms DP3 by up to 31\% under heavy clutter. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhangzhongbo2213/Attention-DP3.

摘要（中文）：3D点云观测在复杂、杂乱的操作场景中本质上具有模糊性，此时目标物体可能被部分遮挡或与视觉上相似的分心物紧密交织。因此，随着场景复杂度增加，标准的3D扩散策略往往难以定位和利用任务相关的几何信息。我们提出了\textbf{Attention-DP3}，一种空间物体感知的3D扩散策略，在保持DP3扩散骨干网络不变的前提下，通过注意力机制注入物体级几何线索。我们的流程在RGB图像上执行开放词汇2D分割，然后利用标定的相机几何将预测的目标掩码提升至3D空间，从而获得以物体为中心的几何先验。我们通过三场注意力条件化整合这些线索，构建三个互补场：（i）目标性场用于锚定目标物体，（ii）目标内显著性场用于强调目标内任务相关的几何信息，以及（iii）背景性场用于抑制分心物和杂乱。在Adroit、DexArt、MetaWorld以及真实世界的SO101平台上的实验表明，该方法相较DP3持续提升，在各基准测试中达到最先进性能。值得注意的是，随着分心物数量增加，DP3性能急剧下降，而Attention-DP3保持稳定，在重度杂乱环境下相较DP3最高提升31\%。代码已公开于https://github.com/zhangzhongbo2213/Attention-DP3。

Authors: Changbo Yan, Zhongbo Zhang, Zaibin Zhang, Yifan Wang, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu

MoPA: Coordinated Mobile Manipulation via Subsystem-Specific Perception Alignment VLA

mobile manipulation perception alignment Mixture-of-Transformers conditional flow matching dual perceptual streams

简要说明：MoPA提出了一种用于协调移动操作的框架，通过双掩码查询银行实现感知与移动和操作的协调，并使用耦合条件流匹配进行协调动作生成，在ManiSkill-HAB和真实世界任务中达到SOTA。

TLDR: MoPA introduces a framework for coordinated mobile manipulation that uses dual masked query banks to align perception with mobility and manipulation, and coupled conditional flow matching for coordinated action generation, achieving SOTA on ManiSkill-HAB and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Mobile manipulation requires perceptual evidence at different spatial scales for base motion and arm control, while the two action modalities remain kinematically coupled. Existing policies often employ specialized action generation for different subsystems but condition heterogeneous action branches on a shared perceptual representation, leaving subsystem-specific perception-action correspondence implicit. We present MoPA, a framework that aligns perceptual conditioning with mobility and manipulation while preserving coordination at the action level. Dual Perceptual Streams employ two mutually masked query banks to extract separate perceptual representations from a shared vision-language context. Perception2Action Adaptation jointly updates each query bank and its corresponding action stream at every layer of a structured Mixture-of-Transformers decoder, while enabling information exchange between the two action streams. Coupled conditional flow matching learns a joint vector field for coordinated generation of both action chunks. On the ManiSkill-HAB benchmark, MoPA achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three task suites. Across four real-world tasks, MoPA achieves a mean full-task success rate of 76.3%, outperforming the best baseline by 12.5 percentage points. Ablation studies and further analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed design. Website is available at: https://mopa-policy.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：移动操作需要在不同空间尺度上获取感知证据，以支持基座运动与机械臂控制，而这两种动作模态在运动学上保持耦合。现有策略通常为不同子系统采用专门的动作生成模块，但将异构动作分支共享同一个感知表示，导致子系统特有的感知-动作对应关系隐式化。我们提出MoPA，一种将感知条件化与移动和操作对齐、同时在动作层面保持协调的框架。双感知流采用两个相互掩蔽的查询库，从共享的视觉-语言上下文中提取独立的感知表示。感知到动作适配在结构化混合Transformer解码器的每一层联合更新每个查询库及其对应的动作流，同时实现两条动作流之间的信息交换。耦合条件流匹配学习联合向量场，以协调生成两个动作块。在ManiSkill-HAB基准测试中，MoPA在全部三个任务套件上均取得了最先进的性能。在四个真实世界任务中，MoPA实现了76.3%的平均完整任务成功率，比最优基线高出12.5个百分点。消融研究和进一步分析验证了所提设计的有效性。网站地址：https://mopa-policy.github.io/。

Authors: Guangyu Chen, Qiwei Liang, Shaolong Zhu, Tianxing Chen, Zikuan Xiao, Yifan Xie, Lingfeng Zhang, Ping Luo, Renjing Xu, Wenbo Ding

Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories VLA

VLA serving multi-model co-location SLO-aware scheduling edge GPU inference action diffusion transformer

简要说明：Robion是首个面向多机器人、多模型请求的多GPU边缘服务器VLA服务与管理框架，通过流内分离VLM与ADiT阶段并协同多模型以满足时延SLO。

TLDR: Robion is the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets latency SLOs by disaggregating VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via streams and co-locating multiple models.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show high robotic manipulation capabilities via a two-stage design: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) stage followed by an Action Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) stage. Since robots must meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for safety, VLA inference is inherently latency-critical. Meeting these SLOs requires high-end GPUs, yet weight, cost, and power constraints preclude integrating such GPUs on-robot. Prior works offload VLA inference to edge servers that serve many robots on VLA models. However, current VLA systems lack support for multi-request, multi-model execution on a multi-GPU server under SLOs, while existing serving systems for multi-stage models are optimized for throughput and stage disaggregation across separate GPUs, which are ill-suited for the millisecond-scale stages of VLA models. We design Robion, the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets SLOs. Our serving engine disaggregates the VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via two streams, dynamically restricting the SMs on VLM stream so ADiT always finds SMs to run alongside it, and co-locates multiple models by sharing these streams across them, prioritizing requests by least remaining SLO time. Our management engine enables flexible model placements on multi-GPU servers, and integrates an intelligent traffic controller that maximizes per-model batching under the chosen placement while bounding each GPU's load to meet SLOs. For individual models, Robion serves on average 6.7$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ higher robot load within 98% SLO attainment over vLLM-Omni, the most widely used multi-stage serving system, and Monolithic, which runs VLM and ADiT as a single pipeline, respectively. In a large-scale experiment of serving 8 different models on a 4-GPU server, Robion can serve up to 64 robots within 98% SLO attainment.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过两阶段设计展现出强大的机器人操控能力：先由视觉-语言模型（VLM）阶段处理，再由动作扩散 Transformer（ADiT）阶段完成。由于机器人必须满足严格的服务水平目标（SLO）以确保安全，VLA 推理本质上是对延迟高度敏感的。满足这些 SLO 需要高端 GPU，但重量、成本和功耗方面的限制使得在机器人本体上集成此类 GPU 不可行。已有研究将 VLA 推理卸载到边缘服务器，由边缘服务器在 VLA 模型上为多台机器人提供服务。然而，当前的 VLA 系统缺乏在多 GPU 服务器上、在 SLO 约束下支持多请求、多模型执行的能力，而现有的多阶段模型服务系统则是针对吞吐量和跨独立 GPU 的阶段解耦进行优化的，这些设计并不适用于 VLA 模型中毫秒级阶段的特性。我们设计了 Robion，这是首个面向多 GPU 边缘服务器上多机器人、多模型请求的 VLA 服务与管理系统，能够满足 SLO 要求。我们的服务引擎通过双流方式在单个 GPU 内部对 VLM 和 ADiT 阶段进行解耦，动态限制 VLM 流上的流式多处理器（SM）数量，使 ADiT 始终能找到可供其运行的 SM 并行执行，并通过跨模型共享这些流来实现多模型共置，同时按剩余 SLO 时间最少者优先调度请求。我们的管理引擎支持在多 GPU 服务器上灵活部署模型，并集成了智能流量控制器，在既定部署方案下最大化每个模型的批处理规模，同时限制每个 GPU 的负载以满足 SLO。针对单个模型，在 98% SLO 达成率下，Robion 平均可承载的机器人负载分别比当前最广泛使用的多阶段服务系统 vLLM-Omni 高出 6.7 倍，比将 VLM 和 ADiT 作为单一流水线运行的 Monolithic 高出 1.5 倍。在一项在 4-GPU 服务器上服务 8 个不同模型的大规模实验中，Robion 能够在 98% SLO 达成率下支持多达 64 台机器人的服务需求。

Authors: Dionysios Adamopoulos, Nattapol Chanpaisit, Basel Fakhri, Christina Giannoula

ASTRIL-MPC: Autonomous Traversal Framework of Articulated Tracked Robots with Language-Guided Neural-Kinematic MPC Locomotion

articulated tracked robots model predictive control language-guided adaptation learned kinematics urban search and rescue

简要说明：ASTRIL-MPC是一个语言引导的神经运动学模型预测控制框架，用于铰接式履带机器人在城市搜索与救援中的自主穿越，结合学习运动学模型、NMPC和基于LLM的自适应调整，以提高穿越质量并消除碰撞冲击。

TLDR: ASTRIL-MPC is a language-guided neural-kinematic MPC framework for autonomous traversal of articulated tracked robots in urban search and rescue, combining a learned kinematics model, NMPC, and LLM-based adaptive retuning to improve traversal quality and eliminate collision impacts.

Abstract: In urban search and rescue, articulated tracked robots (ATRs) must traverse structured but contact-rich environments such as stairwells and cluttered building interiors. Reliable autonomy remains challenging because robot-terrain interaction (RTI) is hybrid and discontinuous, and effective flipper-track coordination is difficult to model analytically. We present ASTRIL-MPC, a language-guided neural kinematics model predictive control (MPC) framework for autonomous traversal. A learned kinematics model predicts short-horizon task-state increments from a height sequence and recent trajectories; NMPC plans with multi-objective costs and strict feasibility constraints; and a large language model (LLM) proposes bounded updates to selected weights and bounds through a safety-checked interface with range clipping, rate limiting, and consistency checks. The compiled predictor enables a full control cycle within 100 ms. Across three traversal tasks and a multi-height generalization setting, ASTRIL-MPC improves an aggregate traversal-quality score by up to 71% over a non-adaptive NMPC and by 67% over a PPO baseline, while eliminating measurable collision impacts during descent. These results indicate that combining learned kinematics, optimization-based planning, and language-guided retuning yields data-efficient and robust autonomy for articulated tracked robots.

摘要（中文）：在城市搜索与救援中，铰接式履带机器人（ATRs）必须穿越结构复杂但接触密集的环境，例如楼梯井和杂乱的建筑内部。由于机器人-地形交互（RTI）具有混合且不连续的特性，且有效的履带-摆臂协调难以通过解析方法建模，可靠的自主性仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了ASTRIL-MPC，一种基于语言引导的神经运动学模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于自主穿越。学习到的运动学模型根据高度序列和近期轨迹预测短时域的任务状态增量；非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）在严格可行性约束下进行多目标代价规划；大语言模型（LLM）通过带有范围裁剪、速率限制和一致性检查的安全接口，对选定权重和边界提出有界更新建议。编译后的预测器可在100毫秒内完成一个完整控制周期。在三个穿越任务和一个多高度泛化场景中，ASTRIL-MPC相对于非自适应NMPC，其综合穿越质量评分最高提升了71%，相对于PPO基线提升了67%，同时在下坡过程中消除了可测量的碰撞影响。这些结果表明，将学习到的运动学、基于优化的规划以及语言引导的参数调整相结合，能够为铰接式履带机器人带来数据高效且鲁棒的自主性。

Authors: Zhenfeng Gan, Yanbo Chen, Lirong Che, Junbo Tan, Xueqian Wang

Global Path Planner with Multi-Model Switching Locomotion

global path planning pure-pursuit controller multi-model kinematic switching traversability graph Heading-Aware A*

简要说明：本文提出了一种全局路径规划器，通过多模型运动学切换增强纯追踪控制，结合可通行性图和航向感知A*算法，并在四足机器人和四旋翼无人机仿真平台上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a global path planner that enhances pure-pursuit control with multi-model kinematic switching, enabled by a traversability graph and a Heading-Aware A* algorithm, validated on quadruped and quadrotor platforms in simulation.

Abstract: This work enhances global path planning via a pure-pursuit controller with multi-model kinematic switching that sustains plan fidelity across diverse terrains. The system includes a traversability graph for terrain analysis, a Heading-Aware A* algorithm for generating feasible paths, and a multi-model Pure Pursuit controller for dynamic tracking. A core innovation is adaptive kinematic modeling, enabling real-time switching between kinematic models based on terrain features and robot states. This adaptability optimizes path efficiency and energy use in challenging scenarios. We validate the approach in simulation on different platforms, namely the Artaban quadruped and the X3 quadrotor drone, showcasing improved performance, robustness, and adaptability over standard baselines.

摘要（中文）：本工作通过一种结合多模型运动学切换的纯追踪控制器，增强了全局路径规划在多样地形上的规划保真度。该系统包含用于地形分析的可通行性图、用于生成可行路径的航向感知A*算法，以及用于动态跟踪的多模型纯追踪控制器。其核心创新在于自适应运动学建模，能够根据地形特征和机器人状态实时切换运动学模型。这种自适应性在具有挑战性的场景中优化了路径效率和能量消耗。我们在不同平台上通过仿真验证了该方法，即Artaban四足机器人和X3四旋翼无人机，展示了相较于标准基线方法在性能、鲁棒性和适应性方面的提升。

Authors: Pietro Gori, Francesco Iotti, Eduard Zelenay, Rastislav Marko, Michele Pierallini, Franco Angelini, Gabriele Pannocchia, Manolo Garabini

Comfort by Construction: Adaptive, Comfort-Bounded Action Spaces for Learned Driving Policies AutonomousDriving

adaptive action parameterization comfort bounds reinforcement learning driving policies lateral-jerk constraint

简要说明：本文提出一种用于学习型驾驶策略的自适应动作参数化方法，每步重新离散化控制网格以严格满足舒适性约束，避免剧烈操作和网格塌缩；并开发了基于浏览器的工具用于审计和创作驾驶场景。在Waymo开放运动数据集和蛇形绕桩场景中，该方法将舒适性违规率保持在1%以下，同时提升了可导航性。

TLDR: This paper proposes an adaptive action parameterization for learned driving policies that rediscretizes the control grid at each step to strictly enforce comfort bounds, preventing abrupt maneuvers and grid collapse; it also introduces a browser-based tool for auditing and authoring driving scenes. It demonstrates below 1% comfort violations while improving navigability in the Waymo Open Motion Dataset and a slalom scenario.

Abstract: Data-driven driving simulators command accelerations and steering rates from a fixed grid without constraining the realized accelerations and jerks. As a result, reinforcement-learning policies inflate safety metrics through abrupt, last-second maneuvers that lie far outside the range of human driving and would be unacceptable to occupants of a real vehicle, so the metrics measure simulator permissiveness rather than policy quality. Enforcing comfort bounds naively is not enough: lateral limits shrink quadratically with speed, so clamping a static grid saturates it and destroys fine-grained control ("grid collapse"). We propose an adaptive action parameterization that rediscretizes the grid at every step to span exactly the per-step feasible control set, via closed-form inversion of the lateral-jerk constraint. We further present PufferDrive-Editor, a browser-based tool to audit realized kinematics and author kinematically challenging scenes. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset and a hand-authored slalom, our adaptive model holds comfort violations below 1% while outperforming clipped-grid and direct-jerk baselines in navigability.

摘要（中文）：数据驱动的驾驶模拟器从固定网格中输出加速度和转向速率指令，而不对实际产生的加速度和加加速度进行约束。因此，强化学习策略通过突发的、最后一刻的急转操作虚增了安全指标，这些操作远超人类驾驶的范围，在真实车辆中也会让乘员无法接受，导致这些指标衡量的实际上是模拟器的宽松程度，而非策略质量。单纯施加舒适性约束并不足够：横向限制随速度呈二次方缩减，因此对静态网格进行截断会使其饱和，并破坏细粒度的控制能力（即“网格坍缩”）。我们提出了一种自适应动作参数化方法，通过横向加加速度约束的闭式反演，在每一步对网格进行重新离散化，使其恰好覆盖该步的可行控制集合。我们还进一步提出了PufferDrive-Editor，一个基于浏览器的工具，用于审计实际运动学并设计具有动力学挑战性的场景。在Waymo开放运动数据集和手工编写的蛇形绕桩场景上，我们的自适应模型将舒适性违规率保持在1%以下，同时在可导航性上优于截断网格和直接加加速度基线方法。

Authors: Anna Rothenhäusler, Daniel Jost, Raghu Rajan, Faris Janjos, Oliver Scheel, Andreas Look, Joschka Boedecker

Robust Underwater Grasping of Sloped Objects with a Waterproof Passive Adaptive Gripper Manipulation

underwater grasping passive adaptive gripper sloped objects waterproof design variable-stiffness pads

简要说明：本文提出了一种防水被动自适应夹持器，用于在水下环境中稳健抓取倾斜或非对称物体，解决了水下环境中的扭矩滚动和剪切滑动问题。该夹持器结合了用于全局自对准的被动旋转关节和用于局部表面适应的可变刚度垫，在干燥和水下条件下均表现出优异的抓取能力和鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper presents a waterproof passive adaptive gripper designed for robust underwater grasping of sloped or asymmetric objects, addressing torque-driven rolling and shear slip in submerged environments. The gripper combines a passive rotational joint for global self-alignment and variable-stiffness pads for local surface adaptation, demonstrating superior holding capability and robustness in dry and underwater conditions.

Abstract: Robust grasping of everyday objects remains challenging for parallel-jaw grippers, particularly when handling sloped or asymmetric items that induce torque-driven rolling and shear slip. These challenges become even more severe in domestic environments such as kitchens, where objects are often wet or submerged, drastically reducing friction between the gripper and the object. To address these issues, we present a waterproof passive adaptive gripper that combines local and global adaptability for high-performance grasping in the submerged environments. The proposed gripper features a fully waterproof design that integrates a passive rotational joint for global self-alignment on sloped surfaces and passive variable-stiffness pads for local surface adaptation. Experiments in both dry and underwater conditions on various cylindrical and conical objects demonstrate superior holding capability and grasp robustness compared to rigid-pad and fixed-joint baselines. The proposed design offers a practical and robust solution that successfully enables stable underwater manipulation of diverse everyday objects, effectively addressing a critical gap in current underwater robotic grasping for daily-life applications.

摘要（中文）：抓取日常物体对于平行夹爪而言仍具挑战性，尤其是在处理带有斜面或不对称的物体时，这些物体容易引发因扭矩驱动的滚动和剪切滑移。此类挑战在厨房等家庭环境中尤为严峻，因为该环境中的物体常常处于湿润或浸水状态，从而显著降低夹爪与物体之间的摩擦力。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种防水被动自适应夹爪，其结合了局部与全局自适应能力，可在水下环境中实现高性能抓取。该夹爪采用全防水设计，集成了用于斜面全局自对齐的被动旋转关节，以及用于局部表面自适应的被动变刚度垫。在干燥及水下条件下，针对多种圆柱形和圆锥形物体开展的实验表明，相较于刚性垫和固定关节的基线方案，该夹爪在保持能力和抓取稳健性方面表现更优。所提出的设计提供了一种实用且稳健的解决方案，能够成功实现对多种日常物体的稳定水下操作，有效填补了当前面向日常生活应用的水下机器人抓取领域的关键空白。

Authors: Jooyoung Hong, Daewon Hong, Joohyung Kim

Before the Tipping Point: Force-Guided Active Perception for Shape-Agnostic Estimation of 3D Centers of Mass Manipulation

center of mass estimation force-based perception non-prehensile manipulation tipping experiment quasistatic push

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于力的主动感知方法，通过单次亚临界倾斜实验估计未知物体的三维质心，在无需形状先验的情况下实现对多种物体的高精度估计。

TLDR: This paper introduces a force-guided active perception method for estimating the 3D center of mass of unknown objects via a single sub-critical tipping experiment, achieving high accuracy across diverse objects without prior shape information.

Abstract: Estimating the 3D center of mass of unknown objects is challenging when grasping is infeasible, geometry is irregular, or mass distribution is uneven. We present a force-based method that estimates CoM height and mass from a single sub-critical tipping experiment by a robot manipulator. The robot applies a quasistatic elevated push and retract motion, using force-angle measurements recorded during tipping to identify parameters from the object trajectory. Our proposed push-retract cycle mitigates frictional bias, enabling generalized fitting. We experimentally validate our method using a robot manipulator with a six-axis force torque sensor on varying types of objects without prior shape information and without specific models. We also propose a method to prevent toppling, keeping the object in a sub-critical tipping regime by leveraging a safety margin. In experimental studies, our method recovers mass, CoM height, and toppling angle with relative errors below 5.0 percent across all unknown objects. This work demonstrates reliable 3D inertial parameter estimation under proper safety thresholds in tipping. Our proposed method informs and enables reliable non-prehensile manipulation and robotic grasping of challenging objects that were previously infeasible.

摘要（中文）：估计未知物体的三维质心在抓取不可行、几何形状不规则或质量分布不均匀时具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于力的方法，通过机器人操纵器进行单次亚临界倾覆实验来估计质心高度和质量。机器人执行准静态抬升推挤及回缩运动，利用倾覆过程中记录的力-角度测量值来识别物体轨迹中的参数。我们提出的推挤-回缩循环减小了摩擦偏差，实现了广义拟合。我们使用配备六轴力/力矩传感器的机器人操纵器，在无需先验形状信息和特定模型的情况下，对不同类型物体进行了实验验证。我们还提出了一种防止翻倒的方法，通过利用安全裕度使物体保持在亚临界倾覆状态。在实验研究中，我们的方法在所有未知物体上恢复质量、质心高度和倾覆角的相对误差均低于5.0%。这项工作展示了在适当安全阈值下进行倾覆时可靠的3D惯性参数估计。我们提出的方法为具有挑战性物体的可靠非抓取操作和机器人抓取提供了信息支持，使之前不可行的操作成为可能。

Authors: Steven M. Hyland, Jing Xiao, Cagdas D. Onal

A Multi-Vehicle Dataset with Camera, LiDAR, and Radar Sensors and Scanned 3D Models for Custom Auto-Annotation using RTK-GNSS AutonomousDriving

autonomous driving dataset RTK-GNSS 3D vehicle models auto-annotation multi-sensor

简要说明：本文介绍了一个包含相机、LiDAR和雷达传感器的多车辆自动驾驶数据集，并提供扫描的3D车辆模型和RTK-GNSS位姿参考，以支持自定义自动标注和感知算法评估。

TLDR: This paper introduces a multi-vehicle autonomous driving dataset with camera, LiDAR, and radar sensors, plus scanned 3D vehicle models and RTK-GNSS pose references to enable custom auto-annotation and evaluation of perception algorithms.

Abstract: Datasets are a crucial element in the development of perception algorithms. They relate sensor measurement data to annotated reference information and allow for the deduction of sensor and object characteristics. In autonomous driving, the reference data commonly consist of semantic image segmentation, point-wise associations, or bounding box annotations. The dataset proposed in this work, however, aims to dig deeper into the evaluation of measurement principles and provides scanned 3D models of all vehicles together with a pose and continuous kinematics reference obtained by RTK-GNSS. Combined, the state of the complete dynamic surrounding of the sensor vehicle is known for any point in time. Subsequent reference formats can be easily computed in user-defined granularity. This dataset involves single-object and multi-object recordings with seven target vehicles. In particular, measurement effects such as occlusion, as well as reflections, can be evaluated, as the normals of the shape of the target vehicles are known. We describe the dataset, discuss the technical background of its development, and briefly present exemplary evaluations.

摘要（中文）：数据集是感知算法开发中的关键要素。它们将传感器测量数据与标注的参考信息相关联，从而能够推导出传感器及物体的特性。在自动驾驶领域，参考数据通常包括语义图像分割、逐点关联或边界框标注。然而，本工作提出的数据集旨在更深入地评估测量原理，并提供了所有车辆的扫描三维模型，以及通过RTK-GNSS获取的姿态和连续运动学参考。综合来看，传感器车辆周围完整动态环境的状态在任意时间点均为已知。后续参考格式可以根据用户定义的粒度轻松计算。该数据集涵盖了七辆目标车辆的单目标和多目标记录。特别是，由于目标车辆形状的法线已知，因此可以评估遮挡和反射等测量效应。我们描述了该数据集，讨论了其开发的技术背景，并简要展示了示例性评估结果。

Authors: Philipp Berthold, Bianca Forkel, Mirko Maehlisch

VertexCBF: Improving Neural Control Barrier Functions via Vertex-Restricted Control Search Other

Neural Control Barrier Functions Control-affine dynamics Hamilton-Jacobi reachability GPU-parallel tree search Mobile robot safety

简要说明：本文提出VertexCBF，一种可扩展且可解释的神经控制屏障函数学习框架，可恢复大型安全集，并在15个系统及移动机器人避障硬件实验中验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces VertexCBF, a scalable and explainable framework for learning neural Control Barrier Functions that recovers large safe sets for autonomous robots, with validation on 15 systems and a hardware demonstration with a mobile robot avoiding pedestrians.

Abstract: As the number of autonomous robots continues to grow, safety becomes increasingly important. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a theoretically grounded framework for ensuring safety, but existing design methods often face limitations in effectiveness, scalability, or interpretability, and may result in overly conservative safe sets. In this paper, we propose \emph{VertexCBF}, a framework for learning neural CBFs in a scalable, systematic, and explainable way. We approximate the stationary Hamilton--Jacobi value function using a neural network trained via a combination of physics-informed and sparsely supervised learning. By exploiting control-affine dynamics and a convex polytope control set, under which the Hamiltonian is maximized at the control vertices, we efficiently generate supervision points via GPU-parallel vertex-restricted tree search, while a residual architecture guarantees that the learned CBF is never larger than the specified constraint function. We evaluate the method on 15 systems and compare it against relevant baselines, showing that it reliably recovers large safe sets where the baselines are conservative or fail completely. In addition, we perform a hardware experiment in which a mobile robot safely avoids pedestrians using a neural CBF trained with our method.

摘要（中文）：随着自主机器人数量持续增长，安全性变得愈发重要。控制屏障函数（CBFs）为保障安全性提供了理论基础完备的框架，但现有设计方法在有效性、可扩展性或可解释性方面常存在局限，且可能导致安全集合过于保守。本文提出 \emph{VertexCBF}，一种以可扩展、系统化且可解释的方式学习神经控制屏障函数的框架。我们利用结合物理信息学习与稀疏监督学习的神经网络，逼近稳态Hamilton--Jacobi值函数。通过利用控制仿射动力学和凸多面体控制集（在该控制集下，Hamilton量在控制顶点处取得最大值），我们借助GPU并行顶点受限树搜索高效生成监督点，同时采用残差架构确保所学CBF始终不超过指定的约束函数。我们在15个系统上评估了该方法，并与相关基线进行了对比，结果表明该方法能够可靠地恢复大规模安全集合，而基线方法在这些场景下要么保守，要么完全失效。此外，我们进行了硬件实验，移动机器人使用基于我们方法训练的神经CBF安全避让行人。

Authors: Bojan Derajić, Sebastian Bernhard, Wolfgang Hönig

High-Fidelity Multi-Body Simulator for Autonomous Racing AutonomousDriving

high-fidelity vehicle dynamics autonomous racing digital twin Functional Mock-up Unit software-in-the-loop

简要说明：本文介绍了一个用于自动驾驶赛车的高保真、实时的多体车辆动力学仿真器，在Dymola中构建并导出为FMU，并通过实验数据进行校准和验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a high-fidelity, real-time multi-body vehicle dynamics simulator for autonomous racing, built in Dymola and exported as an FMU, with calibration and validation from experimental data.

Abstract: We present a custom high-fidelity vehicle dynamics simulation environment for testing and validation of Autonomous Racing software. The digital twin of the autonomous vehicle is developed in Dymola, using racecar dynamics modeling libraries to build a complete multi-body model. A 3D road surface, including elevation profiles and curbs, is implemented using the Curved Regular Grid (CRG) standard. The model is exported from Dymola as a Functional Mock-up Unit (FMU) and integrated into a custom software-in-the-loop simulator, where communication interfaces with the autonomous racing stack were developed in C++. A calibration procedure based on experimental data is also presented, along with a validation study to further support the quality of the proposed framework. The simulator runs in real time on a portable computer and provides reliable ground truth for algorithms validation prior to real-world deployment.

摘要（中文）：我们展示了一个定制的高保真车辆动力学仿真环境，用于自动驾驶赛车软件的测试与验证。该自动驾驶车辆的数字孪生模型基于Dymola开发，利用赛车动力学建模库构建完整的多体模型。三维路面，包括高程剖面和路缘，采用曲率规则网格（CRG）标准实现。该模型从Dymola导出为功能样机单元（FMU），并集成到定制的软件在环仿真器中，其中与自动驾驶赛车软件栈的通信接口使用C++开发。本文还提出了一种基于实验数据的标定流程，并进行了验证研究，以进一步支持所提框架的质量。该仿真器可在便携式计算机上实时运行，在实际部署前为算法验证提供可靠的地面真值。

Authors: Nicola Musiu, Francesco Iacovacci, Fausto Lupo, Matteo Pini, Giovanni Scapicchi, Francesco Moretti, Eugenio Mascaro, Pietro Musso, Ayoub Raji, Marko Bertogna, Vincenzo Maria Arricale, Angelo Lo Sapio, Alessandro Piccarelli, Garron Fish

Control Architecture for Safe Grasping of Fragile Objects Using a Coarse Position-Controlled Gripper Manipulation

force/torque contact estimation adaptive admittance control position-controlled gripper safe grasping fragile objects

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于几何感知的力/力矩接触估计和自适应导纳控制方法，用于位置控制夹爪，以实现对易碎物体的安全抓取，避免过度变形和滑落。

TLDR: This paper presents a geometry-aware force/torque-based contact estimation and adaptive admittance control for a position-controlled gripper, enabling safe grasping of fragile objects with minimal force and no slippage.

Abstract: Robots are increasingly used in unstructured environments. The need for them to safely grasp unknown objects without damaging them becomes crucial. Humans achieve this by sensing and quickly responding by adjusting their grasping force. Similarly, effective grasp acquisition in robots requires compliant interaction strategies that can adapt to uncertain object properties and adjust to any instabilities during manipulation. We present a geometry-aware force/torque-based contact estimation method for a coarse position-controlled gripper, combined with an adaptive admittance controller for safe grasp acquisition. The desired contact forces are estimated online to keep stable contact with objects of unknown properties. This enables compliant and stable grasps while avoiding excessive forces. Experiments with objects of different sizes, shapes, stiffnesses, and weights show that the proposed algorithm not only prevents slippage but also applies minimal force to safely grasp an object without causing excessive deformation.

摘要（中文）：机器人越来越多地被应用于非结构化环境中，它们在不损坏物体的情况下安全抓取未知物体的需求变得至关重要。人类通过感知并迅速调整抓取力来响应，从而实现这一目标。同样地，在机器人中实现有效抓取需要具备顺应性交互策略，该策略能够适应不确定的物体属性，并在操作过程中对任何不稳定性进行调整。 我们提出了一种基于几何感知的力/力矩接触估计方法，适用于粗位置控制夹爪，并结合自适应导纳控制器以实现安全的抓取获取。期望接触力在线估计，以保持与未知属性物体的稳定接触。这使得在避免过大作用力的同时，实现顺应且稳定的抓取。针对不同尺寸、形状、刚度和重量的物体进行的实验表明，所提出的算法不仅能防止滑落，还能施加最小的力以安全抓取物体，且不会引起过度变形。

Authors: Marko Pavlic, Moritz Geier, Timo Markert, Darius Burschka

Driving Context-guided Model Predictive Planning and Control for Autonomous Car Racing at the Limit and Beyond AutonomousDriving

Model Predictive Control Autonomous Racing Driving Context Cost Blending Vehicle Stability

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的自动驾驶赛车运动规划与控制流程，通过成本混合状态机适应超车、正常行驶和反打方向等驾驶情境，并在全尺寸自动驾驶赛车上验证，圈速接近人类车手的98%。

TLDR: This paper presents a Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based motion planning and control pipeline for autonomous car racing, which uses a Cost Blending state machine to adapt to driving contexts like overtaking and countersteering, validated on a full-scale autonomous racecar achieving lap times within 2% of a human driver.

Abstract: This paper presents a Model Predictive Control-based motion planning and control pipeline for autonomous car racing capable of adapting to different driving contexts, such as overtaking, nominal driving, and countersteering. A Cost Blending state machine manages the identification of different driving contexts and the selection of their predefined weights to be applied to the Model Predictive Planning (MPP) and Control (MPC) modules. The two optimization-based solutions share the same problem formulation and model, differing only in horizon length, rate, tuning, and in their open-loop versus closed-loop approach to maximize the effectiveness of their interaction. The work is validated on the fully autonomous open-wheel racecar Superformula EAV-25, with a lap time achieved that is within 2% of the best human driver reference. The results demonstrate the capability of the solution in driving at the limit of handling, smoothly executing overtaking maneuvers, and quickly reacting to high oversteering conditions to recover the vehicle stability.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于模型预测控制的自动驾驶赛车运动规划与控制流程，能够适应不同的驾驶情境，如超车、常规驾驶及反向转向。通过成本混合状态机，系统可识别不同驾驶情境，并选择预设权重，应用于模型预测规划（MPP）与模型预测控制（MPC）模块。这两个基于优化的解决方案共享相同的问题表述与模型，仅在预测时域长度、执行频率、参数调节及开环与闭环策略上有所区别，以最大化其交互效率。该研究在完全自动驾驶的开轮方程式赛车Superformula EAV-25上进行了验证，其单圈成绩已进入最佳人类驾驶员参考成绩的2%以内。结果表明，该方案能够在操控极限下行驶，平稳完成超车动作，并在剧烈过度转向条件下快速响应，以恢复车辆稳定性。

ROS-Agent MetaTool open-source LLM long-horizon planning mobile robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种带有MetaTool机制的增强型ROS-Agent架构，在执行前强制进行结构化伪代码规划，从而提高了基于开源LLM的移动机器人在长时程任务中的可靠性和效率。

TLDR: This paper presents an enhanced ROS-Agent architecture with a MetaTool mechanism that enforces structured pseudo-code planning before action execution, improving long-horizon task reliability and efficiency for open-source LLM-driven mobile robots.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled more natural human-robot interaction, but open-source models often exhibit unstable long-horizon reasoning and inefficient action execution when deployed in agentic robotic frameworks. This paper presents an enhanced ROS-Agent based architecture that improves task reliability and execution efficiency for agentic robotic systems using open-source LLMs. The proposed system introduces a novel intermediate mechanism, termed the MetaTool, which enforces structured planning prior to action execution. Given a natural-language command, the MetaTool induces the LLM to generate a pseudo-code plan of intended tool invocations, which is stored in the ROS-Agent's scratchpad and persists throughout execution. By explicitly separating planning from execution, the proposed approach reduces execution loops and improves deterministic behavior. The architecture is validated on a custom mobile robotic platform with multimodal perception and motion control capabilities. Experimental results on real-world interactive tasks demonstrate improved task completion and contextual consistency, with up to ~24% gains on complex tasks compared to the baseline framework.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）使得人机交互更加自然，但在智能体机器人框架中部署开源模型时，往往存在长程推理不稳定及动作执行效率低下的问题。本文提出一种基于增强型ROS-Agent的架构，旨在利用开源LLMs提升智能体机器人系统的任务可靠性与执行效率。该系统引入了一种新颖的中间机制——元工具（MetaTool），在动作执行前强制进行结构化规划。给定自然语言指令后，MetaTool引导LLM生成预期工具调用的伪代码计划，并将其存储于ROS-Agent的暂存区中，在执行过程中持续保持。通过将规划与执行明确分离，该方法减少了执行循环，并增强了行为的确定性。该架构在一款具备多模态感知与运动控制能力的定制移动机器人平台上进行了验证。在真实世界交互任务上的实验结果表明，与基线框架相比，该架构在复杂任务上的任务完成率和上下文一致性均有提升，最高提升了约24%。

Authors: Kazi Abrar Mahmud, Nilotpaul Kundu Dhurubo, Tamal Kirttonia, Sabbir Hossain Ujjal, Mohammad Ariful Haque

Quantifying Spectral Differences in Vehicle Kinematics Between Production Autonomous and Human-Driven Vehicles Across Driving Scenarios AutonomousDriving

frequency-domain analysis vehicle kinematics production autonomous vehicles driving scenarios Wasserstein distance

简要说明：本文提出一种频域框架，用于量化量产自动驾驶车辆与人类驾驶车辆在不同真实驾驶场景下的运动学差异，揭示了场景相关的频谱差异。

TLDR: This paper proposes a frequency-domain framework to quantify kinematic differences between production autonomous vehicles (PAVs) and human-driven vehicles (HVs) across diverse real-world driving scenarios, revealing scenario-dependent spectral differences.

Abstract: Differences in vehicle kinematic characteristics between production autonomous vehicles (PAVs) and human-driven vehicles (HVs) have been limitedly investigated by empirical studies. Most recent studies rely on simulation-based models, while some further investigate low-level adaptive cruise control (ACC) systems in controlled experiments. These methods commonly adapt some time-domain metrics to characterize PAV-HV differences across limited driving conditions. However, current PAVs equipped with high-level autonomous driving systems generate driving behaviors in a black box using data-driven models. These fundamentally different mechanisms for generating behaviors may produce distinct kinematic characteristics in traffic. More importantly, these time-domain metrics cannot reflect frequency-related traffic dynamics across different driving scenarios. Thus, this study adapted a real-world PAV dataset with four PAV platforms and developed a frequency-domain framework to quantify kinematic differences between PAVs and HVs across diverse driving scenarios, including varying driving states, lighting, weather, and vehicle densities. The framework transforms kinematic signals into the frequency domain and extracts spectral features, and then compares these features between PAVs and HVs based on kernel density estimation and Wasserstein distance. The results reveal clear scenario-dependent PAV-HV spectral differences. Specifically, speed-related differences were consistently smaller during car-following than cruising, while rainy conditions consistently enlarged acceleration-related differences compared with clear conditions. These findings highlight the necessity of multi-scenario evaluations and demonstrate the value of frequency-domain analysis for characterizing PAV-HV kinematic differences under real-world conditions.

摘要（中文）：生产自动驾驶车辆（PAVs）与人工驾驶车辆（HVs）在车辆运动学特征上的差异，目前尚缺乏充分的实证研究。近期研究多依赖基于仿真的模型，部分研究进一步在受控实验中考察了低层级自适应巡航控制（ACC）系统。这些方法通常采用时域指标来表征PAV与HV在有限驾驶条件下的差异。然而，当前配备高级自动驾驶系统的PAV，其驾驶行为由数据驱动模型以黑箱方式生成，这种根本不同的行为生成机制可能在交通中产生独特的运动学特征。更重要的是，时域指标无法反映不同驾驶场景下与频率相关的交通动态。为此，本研究采用了一个包含四种PAV平台的真实世界PAV数据集，构建了一个频域分析框架，用以量化PAV与HV在不同驾驶场景下的运动学差异，涵盖不同驾驶状态、光照条件、天气状况及车辆密度。该框架将运动学信号转换至频域并提取频谱特征，随后基于核密度估计和Wasserstein距离对PAV与HV的频谱特征进行比较。结果表明，PAV与HV的频谱差异呈现明显的场景依赖性。具体而言，跟车状态下速度相关差异始终小于巡航状态，而雨天条件下加速度相关差异相比晴天显著增大。这些发现凸显了多场景评估的必要性，并验证了频域分析在表征真实条件下PAV与HV运动学差异方面的价值。

Authors: Peiyi Fang, Xiangyu Li, Yonglin Weng, Ke Ma

DRS-VPT: Directly Relocalizing in a Scan with Vision Point Transformers AutonomousDriving

image-to-scan registration camera-LiDAR calibration relocalization vision point transformers zero-shot transfer

简要说明：DRS-VPT 是一种用于图像到扫描点云配准的前馈 Transformer，统一了自动驾驶中的相机-激光雷达标定和室内重定位，具有最先进的性能和零样本迁移能力。

TLDR: DRS-VPT is a feed-forward transformer for image-to-scan registration, unifying camera-LiDAR calibration in autonomous driving and indoor relocalization, with state-of-the-art performance and zero-shot transfer.

Abstract: We present DRS-VPT, a feed-forward transformer architecture for foundational image-to-scan registration. Given query images and a reference 3D point cloud, the model predicts the scan pose and point map alongside the poses and point maps of each camera, all expressed in the first camera's frame. It additionally predicts a coarse-to- fine pyramid of per-point and per-pixel features for direct reprojective alignment of the scan to the first image. This formulation unifies downstream tasks such as camera-LiDAR calibration in autonomous driving and indoor camera-to-map relocalization. A single DRS-VPT model achieves state-of-the-art performance for image-to-LiDAR registration in autonomous driving, competitive indoor relocalization without training map-specific weights, and strong zero-shot transfer to unseen environments. We also show qualitatively that the model learns complex scan-to-image projection properties such as occlusion of back-facing points.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了DRS-VPT，一种用于基础图像到扫描配准的前馈Transformer架构。给定查询图像和参考三维点云，该模型预测扫描姿态和点图，以及每个相机的姿态和点图，所有结果均以第一相机的坐标系表示。此外，模型还预测了逐点和逐像素的从粗到细的特征金字塔，用于将扫描直接重投影对齐到第一幅图像。这一公式统一了多项下游任务，如自动驾驶中的相机-激光雷达标定和室内相机到地图的重定位。单一的DRS-VPT模型在自动驾驶中的图像到激光雷达配准任务上达到了最先进性能，在未针对特定地图训练权重的情况下实现了具有竞争力的室内重定位，并且对未见环境表现出强大的零样本迁移能力。我们还通过定性结果展示了该模型学习了复杂的扫描到图像投影特性，例如背面点的遮挡。
