Authors: Lanke Frank Tarimo Fu, Maurice Fallon

Autonomous Precision Milling of Biological Structures via Generic Anatomical Priors and Active Boundary Perception Manipulation

autonomous milling anatomical priors active boundary perception uncertainty-aware stiffness-based probing

简要说明：本文提出了一种不确定性感知的自主铣削框架，结合通用解剖先验和基于刚度探测的主动边界感知，实现对生物结构的精准铣削，并在生物替代物和体内小鼠颅窗创建中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents an uncertainty-aware autonomous milling framework that combines generic anatomical priors with active boundary perception via stiffness probing, enabling precision milling of biological structures without repeated target-specific imaging. The framework is validated on biological surrogates and in vivo mouse cranial window creation, demonstrating accurate anatomical prior transfer and reliable boundary adaptation.

Abstract: Autonomous precision milling of biological structures is challenged by incomplete knowledge of target geometry, local material thickness, and critical internal boundaries. Subject-specific preoperative models can address geometric and thickness variations, but static models cannot determine boundary status encountered during execution, while repeated target-specific imaging limits scalability. This article presents an uncertainty-aware autonomous milling framework that assigns complementary roles to generic anatomical priors and active boundary perception. A generic anatomical prior provides conservative global guidance and is transformed through semantic-guided registration and hybrid vision-force calibration into robot-executable guidance for individual targets. As milling approaches uncertain boundaries, the robot actively probes the remaining structure and uses relative stiffness changes to estimate boundary status and structural detachability. A state-adaptive controller governs transitions between active perception and spatially selective incremental refinement, repeating this cycle until the termination criterion is satisfied. Hierarchical experiments on biological surrogates and in vivo mouse cranial window creation demonstrate accurate anatomical prior transfer, reliable boundary adaptation, and autonomous precision milling of biological structures.

摘要（中文）：对生物结构的自主精密铣削因对目标几何形状、局部材料厚度及关键内部边界的认识不完整而面临挑战。针对特定患者的术前模型可解决几何及厚度变异问题，但静态模型无法确定执行过程中遇到的边界状态，而重复进行目标特异性成像则限制了可扩展性。本文提出了一种具备不确定性感知能力的自主铣削框架，该框架为通用解剖先验与主动边界感知分配互补角色。通用解剖先验提供保守的全局引导，并通过语义引导配准及视觉-力混合标定转换为针对个体目标的可执行机器人引导。当铣削接近不确定边界时，机器人主动探测剩余结构，并利用相对刚度变化来估计边界状态及结构可分离性。状态自适应控制器管理主动感知与空间选择性增量细化之间的转换，循环往复直至满足终止标准。在生物替代物及活体小鼠颅窗创建上开展的分层实验验证了解剖先验的准确传递、可靠的边界适应以及生物结构的自主精密铣削。

Authors: Enduo Zhao, Xiaofeng Lin, Yifan Wang, Yuhan Song, Weihan Li, Saul Alexis Heredia Perez, Kanako Harada

PATH: Continuous Target Sensing among Autonomous Cooperative Drones Other

multi-UAV tracking target handoff cross-view verification geometry-assisted sensing RGB-D reconstruction

简要说明：PATH 提出了一种几何辅助、平台无关的框架，用于协作无人机之间的连续目标跟踪交接，通过度量三维目标重建和跨视角相互同意握手在视觉模糊条件下实现可靠交接，并在真实世界实验中验证。

TLDR: PATH presents a geometry-assisted, platform-agnostic framework for continuous target tracking handoff between cooperative UAVs, using metric 3D target reconstruction and a cross-view mutual agreement handshake to achieve reliable handoffs under visual ambiguity, validated in real-world experiments.

Abstract: Continuous target sensing by uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) is constrained by limited flight endurance, motivating the transfer of tracking responsibility between cooperating UAVs. Such a handoff requires the receiver to identify the same physical target currently tracked by the sender despite differences in viewpoint, scale, and target appearance. Existing approaches based on global target localization or appearance-based cross-view association are limited by positioning uncertainty or ambiguous visual features. This paper presents Perspective Alignment \& Tracking Handoff (\textbf{PATH}), a platform-agnostic, geometry-assisted sensing and verification framework for target handoff between two moving UAVs. The sender reconstructs the tracked target as a metric 3D point using RGB-D sensing, while the receiver estimates its relative pose from a fiducial observation and projects the transmitted target point into its own image as a spatial prior for target acquisition. The receiver-generated candidate is then returned to the sender and verified through a cross-view Mutual Agreement Handshake before tracking responsibility is transferred. Real-world UAV experiments show mean relative-position and target-position errors of 0.047~m and 0.030~m, respectively. Under visually ambiguous conditions, PATH achieves 96.0\% frame-level receiver-side target acquisition accuracy, with 2.0\% false-positive and 2.0\% false-negative rates. A sensor-error sensitivity analysis shows that relative-pose uncertainty is the dominant contributor to receiver-view projection error. The implementation operates at video rate with compact inter-UAV communication below 16~kB/s at 60~Hz, demonstrating the feasibility of lightweight geometry-assisted target handoff on resource-constrained UAV platforms.

摘要（中文）：无人机（UAV）的持续目标感知受限于其有限的续航时间，因此需要在多个协作无人机之间转移跟踪责任。这种交接要求接收方在视角、尺度及目标外观存在差异的情况下，仍能识别出发送方当前跟踪的同一物理目标。现有的基于全局目标定位或基于外观的跨视角关联方法受限于定位不确定性或模糊的视觉特征。本文提出了一种平台无关、几何辅助的感知与验证框架——**视角对齐与跟踪交接（PATH）**，用于两架运动无人机之间的目标交接。发送方利用RGB-D感知将所跟踪目标重建为度量三维点，接收方则通过基准标记观测估计自身相对位姿，并将传输的目标点投影到自身图像中，作为目标获取的空间先验。随后，接收方生成的候选目标被返回给发送方，通过跨视角的相互一致握手协议进行验证，完成跟踪责任的转移。实际无人机实验表明，平均相对位置误差和目标位置误差分别为0.047米和0.030米。在视觉模糊条件下，PATH实现了96.0%的帧级接收方目标获取准确率，误检率为2.0%，漏检率为2.0%。传感器误差敏感性分析表明，相对位姿不确定性是接收方视角投影误差的主要来源。该系统以视频速率运行，机间通信数据量在60Hz频率下低于16kB/s，展示了轻量级几何辅助目标交接在资源受限无人机平台上的可行性。

Authors: Heegyeong Kim, Alice James, Avishkar Seth, Endrowednes Kuantama, Jane Williamson, Yimeng Feng, Richard Han

Understanding Whole-Body Robot Teleoperation Strategies Under Diverse Task Objectives and Constraints Manipulation

whole-body teleoperation mobile manipulation bimanual manipulation user study hybrid control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于TIAGo移动操纵器全身遥操作的混合控制框架，并通过用户研究分析了不同任务约束下操作员的控制策略，发现协调控制能提高效率并降低关节极限风险。

TLDR: This paper presents a hybrid control framework for whole-body teleoperation of a TIAGo mobile manipulator and a user study analyzing operator strategies under different task constraints, finding that coordinated control improves efficiency and reduces joint limit risks.

Abstract: This work investigates the control strategies of complex whole-body robot teleoperation that coordinate active perception, bimanual manipulation, and navigation. We developed a hybrid control framework, combining the free-form and constrained control, for the whole-body teleoperation of the TIAGo mobile manipulator. We conducted a user study to explore people's control strategies under different task constraints such as limited time and low tolerance of errors. Our results highlight the effective use of coordinated control in improving task efficiency and reducing the risk of reaching individual joint limits. We discuss our results and their implications for designing future whole-body robot teleoperation systems.

摘要（中文）：本研究探讨了复杂全身机器人遥操作的控制策略，该策略协调主动感知、双臂操作与导航功能。我们开发了一种混合控制框架，融合了自由形式控制与受限控制，用于TIAGo移动操作机器人的全身遥操作。我们开展了一项用户研究，以探索在有限时间和低错误容忍度等不同任务约束下人们的控制策略。我们的研究结果突显了协调控制在提升任务效率和降低达到单个关节极限风险方面的有效性。我们讨论了这些结果及其对未来全身机器人遥操作系统设计的启示。

Authors: Tsung-Chi Lin, Juo-Tung Chen, Chien-Ming Huang

Mission Performance: Automatic and Adaptive Race Pace Progression for Autonomous Racing AutonomousDriving

autonomous racing performance adaptation laptime progression safety monitoring sector-based

简要说明：本文介绍了用于自动驾驶赛车的 Mission Performance 模块，该模块按扇区自动自适应调整纵向、横向和综合性能目标，以在保证安全的同时加快圈速，并在亚斯码头赛道的 EAV-25 上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents the Mission Performance module for an autonomous racing car, which automatically adaptively adjusts longitudinal, lateral, and combined performance targets per sector to safely speed up lap times, demonstrated on the EAV-25 at Yas Marina Circuit.

Abstract: In this paper, we describe the Mission Performance module implemented for a fully autonomous racing car to automatically manage the longitudinal, lateral, and combined performances, aiming to speedup the laptime progression while assuring safety. Motivated by the difficulty and risks of applying the real-time estimation of the grip to critical modules like the motion planner and controller, the Mission Performance guides these modules adapting their target performance instead of changing the vehicle model parameters. The module is formed by pre-defined progressions to warm up the tires at the beginning of a run. Then, the system continuously monitors safety and vehicle dynamics metrics on a per-sector basis to adaptively reduce, maintain, or increase the performance levels for each sector, progressively converging toward the maximum allowed value. The solution's effectiveness is demonstrated on the EAV-25, a fully autonomous Dallara Superformula, at the Yas Marina Circuit during the Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL) Season 2.

摘要（中文）：本文描述了我们为一辆全自动驾驶赛车所实现的“任务性能”模块，该模块用于自动管理纵向、横向及综合性能，旨在加速单圈时间的提升，同时确保安全性。鉴于将抓地力的实时估计应用于运动规划器与控制器等关键模块存在难度和风险，“任务性能”模块通过引导这些模块调整其目标性能，而非改变车辆模型参数。该模块由预定义的进度序列组成，用于在赛程开始时对轮胎进行预热。随后，系统按扇区持续监控安全与车辆动力学指标，从而自适应地降低、维持或提升各扇区的性能水平，逐步收敛至最大允许值。该方案的有效性已在阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联赛（A2RL）第二赛季的亚斯码头赛道上，通过全自动驾驶Dallara Superformula赛车EAV-25得到验证。

Authors: Giovanni Lambertini, Matteo Pini, Nicola Musiu, Ayoub Raji, Francesco Iacovacci, Marko Bertogna

Amortized Low-Rank Adaptation for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning WorldModel

world models low-rank adaptation hypernetwork model-based reinforcement learning test-time adaptation

简要说明：CLAW 提出使用超网络为世界模型生成低秩适配器，在模型强化学习中实现对未知环境的快速、表达力强的少样本适应，优于梯度基和上下文化适应方法。

TLDR: CLAW introduces a hypernetwork that generates low-rank adapters for world models, enabling fast and expressive few-shot adaptation to new environments in model-based RL, outperforming gradient-based and in-context adaptation.

Abstract: World models let agents plan by predicting the consequences of their actions, but changes in the environment can make them inaccurate. We study the problem of adapting a world model to an unknown test-time environment, drawn from a known environment family, using only a few episodes of interaction. Existing approaches trade off computational cost against expressivity, i.e., the range of models a method can produce. For example, in-context learning is computationally cheap but limited in expressivity, and gradient-based adaptation is expressive but computationally expensive. We present CLAW (Context-conditioned Low-rank Adaptation of World models), which addresses this tradeoff by using a hypernetwork to generate low-rank (LoRA) adapters at test time. During pretraining, we simulate adaptation to a variety of environments and jointly train the hypernetwork and base world model. At test time, we freeze the base model and use a forward pass of the hypernetwork to generate adapters from a small batch of test-time transitions. We evaluate CLAW in locomotion and manipulation environment families that vary in dynamics, embodiment, and reward. We show that, using only seconds of test-time data, CLAW outperforms gradient-based adaptation and in-context learning during online adaptation. We also show that CLAW avoids overfitting in data-scarce regimes, that its advantage comes from the expressive adapters rather than context conditioning, and that pretraining the hypernetwork jointly with the base model outperforms training it post hoc.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使智能体能够通过预测其行为后果来进行规划，但环境的变化可能导致这些模型变得不准确。本文研究如何在仅使用少量交互回合的情况下，使世界模型适应来自已知环境族的未知测试时环境。现有方法在计算成本与表达能力（即方法所能产生的模型范围）之间进行权衡。例如，上下文学习计算成本低但表达能力有限，而基于梯度的适应方法表达能力强但计算成本高。我们提出CLAW（基于上下文条件的低秩世界模型自适应），该方法通过在测试时使用超网络生成低秩（LoRA）适配器来解决这一权衡问题。在预训练阶段，我们模拟对多种环境的适应性，并联合训练超网络和基础世界模型。在测试时，我们冻结基础模型，并通过超网络的前向传播从少量测试时转移数据中生成适配器。我们在运动控制和操作环境族中评估CLAW，这些环境在动力学、实体形态和奖励方面各不相同。结果表明，仅使用数秒的测试时数据，CLAW在在线适应中的表现优于基于梯度的适应方法和上下文学习。我们还表明，CLAW在数据稀缺情况下能避免过拟合，其优势来自具有表达能力的适配器而非上下文条件，并且将超网络与基础模型联合预训练优于事后训练超网络。

Authors: Fernando Palafox, David Fridovich-Keil

DIA: Denoising Intermediate Advantage for Diffusion Policy Optimization Manipulation

Diffusion Policy Reinforcement Learning Credit Assignment Robotic Manipulation Policy Optimization

简要说明：本文提出去噪中间优势（DIA），一种策略梯度方法，学习部分去噪动作的值函数，为机器人操作中扩散策略微调提供逐步信用分配，在多个基准上提升性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Denoising Intermediate Advantage (DIA), a policy-gradient method that learns a value function over partially denoised actions to provide step-wise credit assignment for diffusion policy fine-tuning in robotic manipulation, improving performance across multiple benchmarks.

Abstract: Diffusion-based robot policies have become widely used in robotic manipulation, where they are typically trained with behavior cloning. However, policies trained purely from demonstrations are limited by the quality and coverage of the available data. Reinforcement learning can further improve the performance of these pretrained policies through interaction. A common approach is to use policy-gradient methods that formulate diffusion-policy fine-tuning as an outer environment MDP together with an inner denoising MDP. However, existing methods typically assign the same environment-level credit to all denoising steps used to construct an action chunk, without distinguishing which intermediate decisions contributed most to the final return. We introduce Denoising Intermediate Advantage (DIA), a policy-gradient method that learns a value function over partially denoised actions and uses it to construct a denoising level advantage for each step of the generative process. DIA combines this inner credit signal with the standard environment-level PPO advantage, providing state-dependent credit throughout the denoising chain. Across Robomimic, FurnitureBench, Franka Kitchen, and D3IL, DIA consistently improves final performance over existing diffusion-policy fine-tuning methods. Beyond final reward, DIA reaches successful states more efficiently and can shift farther from the pretrained behavior distribution, enabling it to discover more effective and efficient task-level strategies and subtask sequences that baseline methods fail to reach.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散的机器人策略在机器人操作领域已被广泛采用，通常通过行为克隆进行训练。然而，仅从示范数据训练的策略受限于现有数据的质量和覆盖范围。强化学习可以通过交互进一步提升这些预训练策略的性能。一种常见的方法是使用策略梯度方法，将扩散策略的微调构建为外部环境MDP与内部去噪MDP的组合。然而，现有方法通常将相同的环境层级信用分配给用于构建动作块的所有去噪步骤，而未区分哪些中间决策对最终回报的贡献最大。我们提出了去噪中间优势（DIA），这是一种策略梯度方法，它学习一个关于部分去噪动作的价值函数，并利用该函数为生成过程的每一步构建去噪层级优势。DIA将此内部信用信号与标准的环境层级PPO优势相结合，在整个去噪链中提供状态相关的信用分配。在Robomimic、FurnitureBench、Franka Kitchen和D3IL基准上，DIA consistently提升了现有扩散策略微调方法的最终性能。除了最终奖励外，DIA还能更高效地到达成功状态，并能更远地偏离预训练行为分布，从而发现基线方法无法达到的更有效、更高效的任务级策略和子任务序列。

Authors: Arjun Sohal, Yuchi Zhao, Miroslav Bogdanovic, Alan Aspuru-Guzik

A Data-Driven Distributed Control Scheme: Learning Multi-Objective Agent-Based MPC for Path-Tracking AutonomousDriving

agent-based MPC ADMM learning-based initialization path-tracking autonomous vehicles

简要说明：本文提出一种学习型多目标基于智能体的MPC方案，用于自动驾驶车辆的路径跟踪，通过ADMM解耦目标和控制器，并利用基于学习的初始化加速收敛，在保持与集成MPC相同性能的同时大幅降低计算时间。

TLDR: This paper proposes a learning multi-objective agent-based MPC (AMPC) scheme for autonomous vehicle path-tracking with multiple controllers, using ADMM to decouple objectives and agents and a learning-based initialization to accelerate convergence, achieving the same performance as integrated MPC with significant computational savings.

Abstract: Agent-based model predictive control (AMPC) has recently been proposed for vehicle systems with various controllers, such as differential braking and torque vectoring, where controllers are regarded as distributed agents contributing to the same objective. However, this scheme is challenging in handling multiple conflicting objectives with coupled agents. A common approach for such tasks is the integrated MPC, where all objectives and agents are stacked together in one optimization. Nevertheless, as more agents and objectives are involved, the integrated MPC will face challenges like computational burdens and maintenance difficulties in practice. To this end, this paper proposes a learning multi-objective AMPC that can improve design flexibility and computing efficiency. First, under the assumption of information exchange, a multi-objective AMPC tailored from the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is proposed to decouple the system and achieve the same performance as the integrated scheme iteratively. Second, a learning-based method for initializing iterations is proposed to accelerate convergence. In addition, a data management method is proposed for real-time efficiency, and an authentication module is designed for learning reliability. We compare the proposed scheme against the integrated scheme via a combined path-tracking simulation for autonomous vehicles with various controllers. The proposed scheme achieves the same control performance as the integrated one while reducing the computational time by 43.5%. Furthermore, the learning-based method saves 88.6% more computational time than without learning, making it suitable for real-time implementation.

摘要（中文）：基于智能体的模型预测控制（AMPC）近年来被提出用于配备多种控制器（如差动制动和扭矩矢量分配）的车辆系统，其中各控制器被视为分布式智能体，共同致力于实现同一目标。然而，该方案在处理具有耦合智能体的多冲突目标时面临挑战。对此类任务的常见处理方式是集成模型预测控制，即将所有目标和智能体整合到单一优化问题中。但随着智能体和目标数量的增加，集成MPC在实际应用中将面临计算负担和维保困难等挑战。为此，本文提出了一种学习型多目标AMPC，能够提升设计灵活性和计算效率。首先，在信息交互的假设下，提出了一种基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）定制的多目标AMPC，以解耦系统并迭代地实现与集成方案相同的性能。其次，提出了一种基于学习的迭代初始化方法以加速收敛。此外，提出了面向实时计算效率的数据管理方法，并设计了用于保障学习可靠性的认证模块。我们通过自动驾驶车辆配备多种控制器的联合路径跟踪仿真，将所提方案与集成方案进行了对比。结果表明，所提方案在实现与集成方案相同控制性能的同时，计算时间减少了43.5%。进一步地，基于学习的方法相比无学习方法节省了88.6%的计算时间，使其适用于实时实现。

Authors: Jiaming Zhong, Reza Valiollahi Mehrizi, Yash Vardhan Pant, Amir Khajepour

SCQ: Stabilizing Conservative Q-Learning with Sigmoid-Bounded Entropy RLRobot

offline-to-online reinforcement learning conservative Q-learning sigmoid-bounded entropy real-robot learning stability

简要说明：SCQ提出了一种基于sigmoid的有界熵公式，替代保守Q学习中的标准对数熵项，以减少离线到在线强化学习中的价值估计不稳定性，并在D4RL基准和四个真实机器人平台上（操作、轮式、四足、人形）验证了效果。

TLDR: SCQ introduces a sigmoid-bounded entropy formulation to replace the standard log-entropy term in conservative Q-learning, mitigating value estimation instability in offline-to-online RL. It validates on D4RL benchmarks and transfers to four real-robot platforms including manipulation, wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid systems.

Abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning reduces interaction cost for real-world robot learning but suffers from persistent value estimation instability. Existing methods address this through pessimistic regularization, lower-bound calibration, and architectural normalization, but an overlooked source of instability lies in the entropy formulation: the standard log-entropy term can become negative, destabilizing policy updates. We introduce SCQ (Sigmoid-Bounded Conservative Q-Learning), which replaces this term with a sigmoid-bounded formulation that stays strictly positive. SCQ retains conservative Q regularization and return-based lower-bound calibration, stabilizing policy optimization without sacrificing exploration. We evaluate SCQ on D4RL (Minari) benchmarks under both single-demonstration and standard dataset settings, as well as on simulation and real-world visual tasks. SCQ matches or exceeds baseline performance while exhibiting more stable training dynamics across state-based and visual benchmarks, and transfers to four real-robot platforms including manipulation, wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid systems. A direct clipping intervention that removes negative log-probability contributions, together with gradient-matched positive-score controls, indicates that positivity rather than a particular score shape alone drives much of the improvement. Project website: https://scq-rl.github.io.

摘要（中文）：离线到在线强化学习降低了真实世界机器人学习的交互成本，但持续面临价值估计不稳定的问题。现有方法通过悲观正则化、下界校准和架构归一化来应对这一问题，但一个被忽视的不稳定来源在于熵公式：标准的对数熵项可能变为负值，从而破坏策略更新的稳定性。我们提出了SCQ（Sigmoid有界保守Q学习），该方法用严格保持正值的sigmoid有界公式替代了这一项。SCQ保留了保守Q正则化和基于回报的下界校准，在不牺牲探索能力的前提下稳定策略优化。我们在D4RL（Minari）基准上，于单演示和标准数据集设置下对SCQ进行了评估，并在仿真及真实世界视觉任务中进行了测试。SCQ在达到或超越基线性能的同时，在基于状态和视觉的基准上展现出更稳定的训练动态，并成功迁移至四个真实机器人平台，包括操作、轮式、四足和人形系统。直接裁剪干预去除负对数概率贡献，并结合梯度匹配的正分数对照实验表明，正是正性而非特定的分数形状，在很大程度上推动了性能提升。项目网站：https://scq-rl.github.io。

Authors: Xiefeng Wu, Shu Zhang, Zhaojie Chu, Mingyu Hu

Pedestrian Crossing Intent Classification From Event-Based Vision Using Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks With Temporal Augmentation AutonomousDriving

pedestrian crossing intent event-based vision spiking neural network temporal augmentation autonomous driving

简要说明：该论文提出了一种卷积脉冲神经网络管道，将真实驾驶录影和模拟数据转换为合成事件流，用于行人过街意图分类，在JAAD和DVS-PedX数据集上取得了较高准确率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a convolutional spiking neural network pipeline that converts real-world driving footage and simulated data into synthetic event streams for pedestrian crossing intent classification, achieving high accuracy on the JAAD and DVS-PedX datasets.

Abstract: Anticipating whether a pedestrian will cross the road is safety-critical for autonomous vehicles, requiring real-time inference under challenging conditions including motion blur, high dynamic range, and class imbalance. Conventional frame-based deep networks process redundant RGB data at fixed frame rates, limiting their temporal resolution and energy efficiency. In this work we present an end-to-end pipeline that (i) converts real-world driving footage from the Joint Attention in Autonomous Driving (JAAD) dataset into synthetic dynamic vision sensor (DVS) event streams using the v2e simulator, (ii) augments training with the CARLA-simulated DVS sequences of the DVS-PedX dataset under both normal and adverse weather conditions, and (iii) trains a novel convolutional spiking neural network (Conv-SNN) with clip-consistent DVS augmentation to classify pedestrian crossing intent as binary: crossing or non-crossing. We detail all architectural decisions, the exact leaky-integrate-and-fire neuron dynamics with surrogate-gradient learning, the class-balanced loss formulation, JAAD oversampling at 6x, and a 70/15/15 stratified splitting protocol. The trained model achieves 95.83% accuracy and F1 = 0.9695 on the JAAD DVS test set, 97.79% accuracy and F1 = 0.9478 on normal CARLA DVS, and 94.78% accuracy and F1 = 0.8369 on adverse-weather CARLA DVS, all from a 1.07M-parameter architecture trained on CPU. Compared to prior frame-based approaches on JAAD, our method closes or surpasses the reported accuracy while operating natively on sparse temporal representations. We include a thorough analysis of the convergence behaviour across all 15 training epochs, domain transfer characteristics, and a quantitative comparison with representative related work.

摘要（中文）：预测行人是否将穿越道路对于自动驾驶汽车而言是安全关键任务，需要在运动模糊、高动态范围和类别不平衡等具有挑战性的条件下进行实时推理。传统的基于帧的深度网络以固定帧率处理冗余的RGB数据，限制了其时间分辨率和能效。在本工作中，我们提出了一种端到端流水线，该流水线：（i）使用v2e模拟器将自动驾驶联合注意力（JAAD）数据集中的真实驾驶视频转换为合成动态视觉传感器（DVS）事件流；（ii）利用DVS-PedX数据集中CARLA模拟的DVS序列，在正常和恶劣天气条件下增强训练数据；（iii）训练一种新颖的卷积脉冲神经网络（Conv-SNN），并采用片段一致的DVS增强来将行人穿越意图分类为二元类别：穿越或非穿越。我们详细阐述了所有架构决策、带有替代梯度学习的精确泄漏积分-发放神经元动力学、类别平衡损失函数、6倍JAAD过采样以及70/15/15分层划分协议。训练后的模型在JAAD DVS测试集上达到95.83%的准确率和F1=0.9695，在正常CARLA DVS上达到97.79%的准确率和F1=0.9478，在恶劣天气CARLA DVS上达到94.78%的准确率和F1=0.8369，所有这些均来自一个在CPU上训练的1.07M参数架构。与JAAD上先前基于帧的方法相比，我们的方法在原生处理稀疏时间表示的同时，缩小或超越了所报告的准确率。我们纳入了对全部15个训练轮次的收敛行为、领域迁移特性的深入分析，以及与代表性相关工作的定量比较。

Authors: Henok Teklu, Mustafa Sakhai, Maciej Wielgosz, Matej Mertik

From Transportation to Manipulation: Enabling Grasping in Magnetic Robotics Manipulation

magnetic levitation 6-DoF manipulation gripper design pick-and-place inverse kinematics

简要说明：本文介绍了Gripper MagBot，一种低成本6自由度机械手，集成了1自由度夹爪，通过机械耦合三个磁悬浮动子，无需额外处理设备即可在磁悬浮系统上实现抓取和拾放操作。

TLDR: This paper presents the Gripper MagBot, a low-cost 6-DoF manipulator with an integrated gripper that mechanically couples three magnetic levitation movers, enabling grasping and pick-and-place directly on MagLev systems without additional handling equipment.

Abstract: Magnetic levitation (MagLev) systems have great potential for application in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing due to their scalability and flexibility, enabling highly reconfigurable in-machine material flow. However, their manipulation capabilities remain largely unexploited, as current applications almost exclusively focus on transportation. To enable grasping and manipulation directly on MagLev systems without requiring additional costly handling equipment, such as industrial robot arms, we present the Gripper MagBot, a low-cost parallel 6-DoF manipulator with an integrated 1-DoF gripper that mechanically couples three MagLev movers. The Gripper MagBot supports two operating configurations: a default mode and a single-track mode, selectable depending on the required stability and workspace footprint. To reconfigure a machine, the MagBot can be autonomously dropped off and picked up using a docking station. We showcase pick-and-place examples in simulation, as well as with the real Gripper MagBot using our inverse kinematics controller. CAD files, assembly instructions, a component list, and videos are available at https://sites.google.com/view/gripper-magbot.

摘要（中文）：磁悬浮（MagLev）系统因其可扩展性和灵活性，在高混合、小批量制造中具有巨大的应用潜力，能够实现高度可重构的机内物料流。然而，其操作能力在很大程度上尚未被充分利用，当前应用几乎仅限于运输领域。为了实现无需额外昂贵处理设备（如工业机器人臂）的磁悬浮系统直接抓取与操作，我们提出了Gripper MagBot——一种低成本并行6自由度机械臂，集成1自由度夹爪，通过机械耦合三个磁悬浮动子。Gripper MagBot支持两种操作配置：默认模式和单轨模式，可根据所需稳定性与工作空间占用进行选择。为重构机器，MagBot可通过对接站自主下放与拾取。我们在仿真中展示了拾放示例，并使用我们的逆运动学控制器在真实Gripper MagBot上进行了验证。CAD文件、装配说明、组件清单及视频可在https://sites.google.com/view/gripper-magbot获取。

Authors: Lara Bergmann, Noah Greis, Cedric Grothues, Lisa-Marie Weigelt, Klaus Neumann

ProClosure: Hierarchical Room-Object Assignment using Progressive Boundary Closure from Monocular Video Perception3D

3D scene graph room segmentation monocular video Progressive Boundary Closure object-to-room assignment

简要说明：本文提出了渐进边界闭合方法，从单目RGB视频中恢复房间分割，提高了机器人3D场景图中物体到房间的分配准确性。

TLDR: The paper introduces Progressive Boundary Closure, a method that recovers room segmentation from monocular RGB video for robots, improving object-to-room assignment in 3D scene graphs compared to prior work.

Abstract: A 3D scene graph groups objects into rooms. When a robot is asked to fetch an object from the kitchen, that grouping is what tells it where to look. An object recorded in the wrong room is not retrievable by a query naming the correct room. We introduce Progressive Boundary Closure, which recovers room layer from a monocular RGB video. A SLAM front end and an open-vocabulary segmenter supply a structural point cloud, camera trajectory and object tracks. The cloud is rasterised into a top-down map, rooms are recovered from it, and each object takes the room holding most of its extent. The difficulty lies in the map itself. Walls are recorded only where the camera looked, so a gap in the boundary may be a doorway or a stretch of wall that was never observed; nothing distinguishes the two. Prior methods treat both as passages, merging rooms that should remain separate. We observe that both require the same treatment: a room should not extend across either, so both are closed and need not be distinguished. Such an opening closes under a small amount of boundary growth, and few sightlines cross it, so points in different rooms rarely see one another. We use the first to recover rooms and the second to assign objects to them. Rooms are obtained by Progressively thickening the boundary inward and freezing each free-space region once it becomes enclosed, so every opening seals at its own scale rather than at a radius fixed in advance. Camera poses are used as seeds, which removes the sampling heuristic and makes the segmentation deterministic. Over 10 floors of 6 HM3D-Semantics scenes, scored against HOV-SG on identical top-down maps, we recover 74 rooms for 72 annotated regions (HOV-SG: 44), raising room F_1 from 0.741 to 0.890 at IoU 0.25 at some cost in precision, and object-to-room ARI from 0.488 to 0.696 (p=0.002, ahead on every floor).

摘要（中文）：三维场景图将物体分组到各个房间中。当机器人被要求从厨房取某件物品时，正是这种分组告诉它该去哪里寻找。若一件物体被记录在错误的房间内，那么以正确房间名称进行的查询将无法检索到它。我们提出渐进式边界闭合方法，该方法能够从单目RGB视频中恢复房间层级。SLAM前端与开放词汇分割器提供结构点云、相机轨迹和物体跟踪信息。点云被栅格化为俯视地图，从中恢复出各房间，每个物体归属于占据其大部分范围的房间。难点在于地图本身。墙壁仅在相机观察到的位置被记录，因此边界上的缺口可能是门洞，也可能是从未被观测到的一段墙壁；二者无法区分。现有方法将两者均视为通道，从而合并了本应保持分离的房间。我们观察到两者需要相同的处理方式：房间不应跨越任何一类缺口，因此两者都应被封闭，无需加以区分。此类开口在少量边界增长下即会闭合，且很少有视线穿越它，因此不同房间中的点几乎无法相互看见。我们利用前者恢复房间，利用后者将物体分配给房间。房间通过将边界向内渐进增厚，并在每个自由空间区域一旦被封闭时将其冻结来获得，从而使每个开口在其自身尺度上密封，而非以预先设定的固定半径密封。相机位姿被用作种子点，这消除了采样启发式，并使分割具有确定性。在6个HM3D语义场景的10个楼层上，在相同的俯视地图上与HOV-SG进行对比评分，我们为72个标注区域恢复了74个房间（HOV-SG：44个），在IoU为0.25时，房间F₁分数从0.741提升至0.890（以一定精确度为代价），物体到房间的ARI从0.488提升至0.696（p=0.002，在每个楼层上均领先）。

Authors: Vinoth Kumar Muthuraj, Soumyadeep Banik, Kushal Sharma, Hardik Jain

Pneumatic neurons for soft robots enable inflate-and-fire networks for rhythmic motion Locomotion

pneumatic neuron soft robotics inflate-and-fire rhythmic motion electronics-free control

简要说明：本文介绍了气动神经元（Pneu-rons），这是一种将能量转换、逻辑和驱动结合在一起的软执行器，能够构建无需电子控制器的自激励网络，从而驱动软体机器人的节律运动。

TLDR: This paper introduces Pneumatic neurons (Pneu-rons), soft actuators that combine energy conversion, logic, and actuation to create electronics-free, self-excitable networks capable of generating rhythmic oscillations for soft robot locomotion.

Abstract: Animals coordinate their movements through distributed neural circuits, but soft robots still typically depend on external, centralized electronics for control. Building soft robots that operate without centralized electronic controllers while remaining responsive to their environment remains a frontier challenge in soft robotics. In this work we introduce a soft-robot control architecture inspired by leaky integrate-and-fire models of biological neural circuits. The Pneumatic neuron (Pneu-ron) is a soft actuator that unifies energy conversion, logic, and actuation in one component. Each module combines a low-boiling-point fluid (LBF), a heater, and a mechanical switch into a self-excitable unit. Boiling the LBF inflates the module and triggers excitation and inhibition of adjacent modules in a process we call "inflate-and-fire". When interconnected into excitatory-inhibitory rings, Pneu-rons generate stable, sequential oscillations whose frequency emerges from the material dynamics and environmental conditions. By harnessing the inflation of Pneu-rons for actuation these networks can drive oscillatory locomotion of soft robots. Pneu-ron networks sustain oscillation under mechanical load and thermal variations, adapting through material physics rather than computation. Dynamical modeling of these networks reveals a dimensionless bifurcation diagram that dictates the network's oscillatory behavior. Encoding logic and actuation into material-level modules presents a new avenue for adaptive, electronics controller-free, soft robots.

摘要（中文）：动物通过分布式的神经回路协调运动，但软体机器人通常仍依赖外部集中式电子控制器。构建无需集中式电子控制器、同时能对环境做出响应的软体机器人，仍是软体机器人领域的前沿挑战。本文提出一种受生物神经回路泄漏积分发放模型启发的软体机器人控制架构。气动神经元（Pneu-ron）是一种将能量转换、逻辑运算与驱动功能集于一体的软体执行器。每个模块将低沸点液体（LBF）、加热器和机械开关组合为一个自激励单元。低沸点液体沸腾使模块膨胀，并触发相邻模块的兴奋与抑制，这一过程我们称之为“膨胀-发放”。当相互连接形成兴奋-抑制环时，气动神经元能够产生稳定的序列振荡，其频率由材料动力学和环境条件共同决定。利用气动神经元的膨胀进行驱动，这些网络可以驱动软体机器人实现振荡运动。气动神经元网络在机械负载和温度变化条件下仍能维持振荡，通过材料物理而非计算实现自适应。对这些网络的动力学建模揭示了一个无量纲分岔图，该图决定了网络的振荡行为。将逻辑和驱动功能编码到材料级模块中，为开发自适应、无需电子控制器的软体机器人开辟了新途径。

Authors: Dongting Li, Michael Tolley, Nick Gravish

Multi-Objective Agent-Based Model Predictive Controller for Plug-and-Play Vehicle Control AutonomousDriving

agent-based model predictive control plug-and-play vehicle control ADMM multi-objective control electric vehicle

简要说明：本文提出了一种多目标基于智能体的模型预测控制（AMPC）方案，将ADMM调整为通用控制策略以解耦目标，并在电动汽车上验证了其收敛性和计算效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a multi-objective agent-based model predictive control (AMPC) scheme that adapts ADMM to decouple conflicting objectives in plug-and-play vehicle control, demonstrating convergence to the global optimum and computational efficiency on an electric vehicle.

Abstract: Functional integration is a growing trend in vehicle control, often involving the coordination of multiple controllers to achieve various objectives simultaneously. The need for flexibility and reliability has led to a "plug-and-play" approach in control system design, which presents challenges for traditional integrated model predictive control (MPC). Agent-based model predictive control (AMPC) has recently emerged as a distributed solution that treats controllers as agents, creating a collaborative framework among them to reach a common goal. However, this approach struggles to manage distributed conflicting objectives when agents are coupled or interdependent. To address this, we propose a novel, practical distributed control scheme called multi-objective AMPC, which adapts the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) into a general control strategy that approximates global optimization while decoupling objectives. We systematically develop three formulations that maintain convergence while addressing control regularization and inequality constraints, applying them to complex vehicle control systems for the first time. The proposed method has been tested on two vehicle control scenarios with a multi-objective topology. Different formulations are compared through simulations, and the most computationally efficient one was implemented on an electric vehicle for real-world evaluations. The results demonstrate that the proposed multi-objective AMPC can converge approximately to the same global optimum as integrated MPC with greater flexibility and the potential to reduce computational costs.

摘要（中文）：功能集成是车辆控制领域的一个日益增长的趋势，通常涉及多个控制器的协调，以同时实现多种目标。对灵活性和可靠性的需求催生了控制系统设计中的“即插即用”方法，这对传统的集成模型预测控制（MPC）提出了挑战。基于智能体的模型预测控制（AMPC）最近作为一种分布式解决方案出现，将控制器视为智能体，在它们之间建立协作框架以达成共同目标。然而，当智能体之间存在耦合或相互依赖时，该方法难以管理分布式冲突目标。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖且实用的分布式控制方案，称为多目标AMPC，它将交替方向乘子法（ADMM）适配为一种通用的控制策略，在解耦目标的同时逼近全局最优。我们系统地开发了三种公式化表述，在保持收敛性的同时处理控制正则化和不等式约束，并首次将其应用于复杂车辆控制系统。所提出的方法已在两个具有多目标拓扑结构的车辆控制场景中进行了测试。通过仿真比较了不同的公式化表述，并将其中计算效率最高的一种应用于实车进行真实世界评估。结果表明，所提出的多目标AMPC能够近似收敛到与集成MPC相同的全局最优解，同时具有更高的灵活性，并有可能降低计算成本。

Authors: Jiaming Zhong, Ladan Khoshnevisan, Shucheng Huang, Mohammad Pirani, Yash Vardhan Pant, Amir Khajepour

Embodied-BenchForge: A Closed-Loop Agentic Workflow for Embodied Benchmark Construction Other

agentic framework benchmark construction closed-loop synthesis verification and repair embodied scenarios

简要说明：Embodied-BenchForge 是一个智能体框架，通过闭环合成与构件验证修复自动化构建具身基准，并在多种具身场景和交互任务中验证。

TLDR: Embodied-BenchForge is an agentic framework that automates embodied benchmark construction via closed-loop synthesis with artifact verification and repair, validated across diverse embodied scenarios and interactive tasks.

Abstract: Agentic systems offer a promising way to automate embodied benchmark construction, but existing approaches typically cover isolated stages or remain specialized to predefined environments and task families. More importantly, multi-step construction produces dependent intermediate artifacts that are often passed downstream without artifact-specific verification, allowing local defects to propagate into the final benchmark. We present Embodied-BenchForge, an agentic framework that transforms user-specified evaluation intents into complete embodied benchmark artifacts. It formulates construction as Closed-Loop Benchmark Synthesis, integrating forward artifact synthesis with backward verification and repair. Skill-Orchestrated Artifact Synthesis composes typed and reusable skills into executable workflows, while an artifact dependency graph records intermediate outputs and their dependencies. Requirement-Guided Verification and Repair applies artifact-specific contracts throughout construction and uses provenance to trigger local re-execution or upstream rollback when verification fails. Embodied-BenchForge constructs six benchmarks covering diverse embodied scenarios in the Offline EQA Track, together with one interactive benchmark containing 220 executable tasks in the Interactive Embodied Track. Evaluations of representative MLLMs and embodied agents show that the benchmarks distinguish model capabilities in both observation-based understanding and closed-loop execution. Quality assessment and ablations validate benchmark quality and the effectiveness of verification and repair, while repair and skill-reuse analyses demonstrate efficient localized recovery and cross-benchmark reusability.

摘要（中文）：代理系统为自动化具身基准构建提供了一种有前景的途径，但现有方法通常仅覆盖孤立阶段，或局限于预定义环境和任务族。更重要的是，多步骤构建会产生相互依赖的中间产物，这些产物通常未经特定于产物的验证就直接传递到下游，导致局部缺陷扩散到最终基准中。我们提出了Embodied-BenchForge，一个代理框架，能够将用户指定的评估意图转化为完整的具身基准产物。它将构建过程形式化为闭环基准综合，整合了前向产物综合与后向验证及修复。技能编排式产物综合将类型化且可复用的技能组合成可执行工作流，同时产物依赖图记录中间输出及其依赖关系。需求引导的验证与修复在整个构建过程中应用特定于产物的契约，并在验证失败时利用溯源信息触发局部重新执行或上游回滚。Embodied-BenchForge在离线EQA轨道中构建了覆盖多种具身场景的六个基准，以及一个包含220个可执行任务的交互式具身轨道交互基准。对代表性多模态大语言模型和具身智能体的评估表明，这些基准在基于观测的理解和闭环执行两方面均能有效区分模型能力。质量评估和消融实验验证了基准质量及验证与修复的有效性，而修复和技能复用分析则展示了高效的局部恢复能力和跨基准的可复用性。
